def test_assessments_run_concurrently_with_configured_bound(monkeypatch):
    ids = [f"NCT0000000{i}" for i in range(1, 5)]
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.agents.workflow.settings.adk_concurrency", 2)
    active = 0
    maximum = 0

    async def assess(**_kwargs):
        nonlocal active, maximum
        active += 1
        maximum = max(maximum, active)
        await asyncio.sleep(.01)
        active -= 1
        return JudgeOutput()

    with (
        patch("app.agents.workflow.extract_patient", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=extracted()),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.ApprovedTrialRetrieval.search", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=[candidate(item, .8) for item in ids]),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.assess_trial", new_callable=AsyncMock, side_effect=assess),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.trials", return_value={item: trial(item) for item in ids}),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.chunks", return_value={}),
    ):
        asyncio.run(run_workflow_async(CASE))
    assert maximum == 2


def test_mocked_assessment_latency_improves_with_bounded_concurrency():
    ids = [f"NCT0000000{i}" for i in range(1, 7)]
    index = {item: trial(item) for item in ids}

    async def delayed_assess(**_kwargs):
        await asyncio.sleep(.03)
        return JudgeOutput()

    async def measure(concurrency):
        with (
            patch("app.agents.workflow.settings.adk_concurrency", concurrency),
            patch("app.agents.workflow.extract_patient", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=extracted()),
            patch("app.agents.workflow.ApprovedTrialRetrieval.search", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=[candidate(item, .8) for item in ids]),
            patch("app.agents.workflow.assess_trial", new_callable=AsyncMock, side_effect=delayed_assess),
            patch("app.agents.workflow.trials", return_value=index),
            patch("app.agents.workflow.chunks", return_value={}),
        ):
            started = time.perf_counter()
            await run_workflow_async(CASE)
            return time.perf_counter() - started

    async def compare():
        serial = [await measure(1) for _ in range(3)]
        concurrent = [await measure(6) for _ in range(3)]
        return statistics.median(serial), statistics.median(concurrent)

    serial_duration, concurrent_duration = asyncio.run(compare())
    print(
        "mocked_full_workflow_median_ms "
        f"concurrency_1={serial_duration * 1000:.1f} "
        f"concurrency_6={concurrent_duration * 1000:.1f}"
    )
    assert concurrent_duration < serial_duration * .8


def test_overall_timeout_cancels_workflow_tasks(monkeypatch):
    cancelled = False

    async def blocked_steps(*_args, **_kwargs):
        nonlocal cancelled
        try:
            await asyncio.Event().wait()
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            cancelled = True
            raise

    monkeypatch.setattr("app.agents.workflow.MAX_WORKFLOW_SECONDS", .01)
    with patch("app.agents.workflow._run_steps", new=blocked_steps):
        with pytest.raises(WorkflowError) as error:
            asyncio.run(run_workflow_async(CASE))
    assert error.value.code == "WORKFLOW_TIMEOUT"
    assert cancelled


def test_verified_exclusion_is_separated_from_shortlist():
    ids = ["NCT00000001"]
    excluded_trial = {
        **trial(ids[0]),
        "eligibility_text": "Age under 40 years.",
    }
    judge_output = JudgeOutput(criteria=[{
        "criterion_type": "INCLUSION",
        "criterion_quote": "Age under 40 years.",
        "patient_evidence_quote": "55-year-old",
        "impact": "BLOCKS",
        "explanation": "The documented age exceeds the stated limit.",
    }])
    with (
        patch("app.agents.workflow.extract_patient", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=extracted()),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.ApprovedTrialRetrieval.search", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=[candidate(ids[0], .9)]),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.assess_trial", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=judge_output),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.trials", return_value={ids[0]: excluded_trial}),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.chunks", return_value={}),
    ):
        response = asyncio.run(run_workflow_async(CASE))
    assert response.matches == []
    assert response.ruled_out_trials[0].nct_id == ids[0]
    assert "Age under 40 years." in response.ruled_out_trials[0].reason


def test_conflicting_age_cannot_be_used_as_assessment_evidence():
    case = "Patient age 55 years old and age 67 years old with breast cancer."
    output = JudgeOutput(criteria=[{
        "criterion_type": "INCLUSION",
        "criterion_quote": "Age must be over 18 years.",
        "patient_evidence_quote": "67 years old",
        "impact": "SUPPORTS",
        "explanation": "The patient is an adult.",
    }])
    with (
        patch("app.agents.workflow.extract_patient", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=PatientExtractionOutput(profile=PatientProfile(primary_conditions=["breast cancer"], search_query="breast cancer"))),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.ApprovedTrialRetrieval.search", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=[candidate("NCT00000001", .9)]),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.assess_trial", new_callable=AsyncMock, return_value=output) as assess,
        patch("app.agents.workflow.trials", return_value={"NCT00000001": {**trial("NCT00000001"), "eligibility_text": "Age must be over 18 years."}}),
        patch("app.agents.workflow.chunks", return_value={}),
    ):
        response = asyncio.run(run_workflow_async(case))

    assessment_case = assess.await_args.kwargs["case"]
    assert "55 years old" not in assessment_case
    assert "67 years old" not in assessment_case
    assert response.conflicting_facts
    assert response.matches[0].verdict == "COULD_NOT_ASSESS"


def test_unknown_criterion_never_improves_verdict_or_rank():
    unknown = CriterionResult(
        source="TRIAL_TEXT", criterion_type="INCLUSION", criterion_quote="Required detail",
        impact="UNKNOWN", explanation="Could not assess from available facts.",
    )
    assert compute_verdict([unknown]) == "COULD_NOT_ASSESS"
    assert compute_verdict([]) == "COULD_NOT_ASSESS"
    from app.agents.workflow import _criterion_priority
    assert _criterion_priority([]) < _criterion_priority([unknown])


def test_agent_output_schemas_reject_unexpected_fields():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unexpected"):
        PatientExtractionOutput.model_validate({
            "profile": {"search_query": "cancer", "action": "call arbitrary tool"},
        })
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        RefinementOutput.model_validate({"refine": True, "tool": "shell"})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        RetrievalQuery(query="breast cancer", action="other")


def test_approved_retrieval_tool_enforces_two_call_bound():
    profile = extracted().profile
    tool = ApprovedTrialRetrieval(case=CASE, profile=profile)
    with patch("app.agents.tools.retrieve", return_value=[]):
        async def search_twice():
            await tool.search("breast cancer")
            await tool.search("tamoxifen")
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="retrieval limit"):
                await tool.search("breast cancer")
        asyncio.run(search_twice())
    assert tool.calls == 2


def test_adk_session_is_created_and_deleted_around_validated_output():
    class FakeEvent:
        content = type("Content", (), {"parts": [type("Part", (), {"text": '{"refine": false, "search_query": ""}'})()]})()
        def is_final_response(self):
            return True

    class FakeRunner:
        def __init__(self, **_kwargs):
            pass
        async def run_async(self, **_kwargs):
            yield FakeEvent()

    class FakeSessions:
        async def create_session(self, **_kwargs):
            return None
        async def delete_session(self, **_kwargs):
            self.deleted = True

    async def run():
        service = FakeSessions()
        client = MagicMock()
        client.aio.aclose = AsyncMock()
        with (
            patch.object(adk_runtime, "LlmAgent"),
            patch.object(adk_runtime, "Gemini"),
            patch.object(adk_runtime, "Runner", FakeRunner),
            patch.object(adk_runtime, "InMemorySessionService", return_value=service),
            patch.object(adk_runtime.genai, "Client", return_value=client) as create_client,
        ):
            result = await adk_runtime.run_structured_agent(
                name="test_agent", instruction="untrusted data", data={"text": "test"},
                output_schema=RefinementOutput,
            )
        assert result.refine is False
        assert service.deleted is True
        create_client.assert_called_once()
        assert create_client.call_args.kwargs["enterprise"] is True
        client.aio.aclose.assert_awaited_once()
        client.close.assert_called_once()
    asyncio.run(run())

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$repoRoot = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..")).Path
$backendEnvPath = Join-Path $repoRoot "backend/.env"
$frontendEnvPath = Join-Path $repoRoot "frontend/.env"

function Read-EnvValue([string]$Path, [string]$Name) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return $null }
    $line = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\s*$([regex]::Escape($Name))\s*=" } | Select-Object -Last 1
    if (-not $line) { return $null }
    return (($line -replace "^\s*$([regex]::Escape($Name))\s*=", "").Trim().Trim('"').Trim("'"))
}

function Invoke-GCloud([string[]]$Arguments) {
    & gcloud @Arguments
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "gcloud failed with exit code ${LASTEXITCODE}: gcloud $($Arguments -join ' ')" }
}

if (-not (Get-Command gcloud -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "Google Cloud CLI (gcloud) is required. Install it and sign in with 'gcloud auth login'." }
if (-not (Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "Node.js and npm are required to build the React frontend." }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $frontendEnvPath)) { throw "Missing frontend/.env. Copy frontend/.env.example to frontend/.env and configure the Firebase web app values before deployment." }

if (-not $firebaseProjectId -or $firebaseProjectId -match "your-|replace|placeholder") { throw "Set VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID in frontend/.env before deployment." }
foreach ($key in @("VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY", "VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN", "VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID")) {
    if (-not (Read-EnvValue $frontendEnvPath $key)) { throw "Set $key in frontend/.env before deployment." }
}

$dataProjectId = Read-EnvValue $backendEnvPath "GCP_PROJECT"
if (-not $dataProjectId) { $dataProjectId = $ProjectId }
$gcpLocation = Read-EnvValue $backendEnvPath "GCP_LOCATION"
if (-not $gcpLocation) { $gcpLocation = $Region }

Write-Host "Firebase project: $firebaseProjectId"
Write-Host "Checking Google Cloud credentials..."
Invoke-GCloud @("auth", "print-access-token") | Out-Null

Invoke-GCloud @("services", "enable", "run.googleapis.com", "cloudbuild.googleapis.com", "artifactregistry.googleapis.com", "--project", $ProjectId, "--quiet")

if (-not $SkipApiDeploy) {
    $apiArgs = @(
        "run", "deploy", $ApiService,
        "--source", (Join-Path $repoRoot "backend"),

    )
    if ($RuntimeServiceAccount) { $apiArgs += @("--service-account", $RuntimeServiceAccount) }
    Invoke-GCloud $apiArgs
}
$apiUrl = (& gcloud run services describe $ApiService --project $ProjectId --region $Region --format "value(status.url)").Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $apiUrl) { throw "Could not read the deployed API URL." }

$buildStage = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("clinical-trial-ui-build-" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $buildStage | Out-Null

    foreach ($item in @("package.json", "package-lock.json", "index.html", "vite.config.js", "src", "public")) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $frontendPath $item) -Destination $buildStage -Recurse

    Push-Location $buildStage
    npm ci
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "npm ci failed in the temporary frontend build directory." }
    $env:VITE_API_BASE_URL = $apiUrl
    npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Frontend production build failed." }
    Pop-Location
    $frontendDist = Join-Path $frontendPath "dist"
    $resolvedFrontend = (Resolve-Path $frontendPath).Path.TrimEnd("\") + "\"
    $resolvedDist = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($frontendDist)
    if (-not $resolvedDist.StartsWith($resolvedFrontend, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        throw "Refusing to replace a build output outside the frontend directory."
    }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $frontendDist) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $frontendDist -Recurse -Force }
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $buildStage "dist") -Destination $frontendDist -Recurse
} finally {
    Remove-Item Env:VITE_API_BASE_URL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ((Get-Location).Path -eq $buildStage) { Pop-Location }
    $resolvedTemp = (Resolve-Path $env:TEMP).Path.TrimEnd("\") + "\"
    $resolvedStage = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($buildStage)
    if ($resolvedStage.StartsWith($resolvedTemp, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resolvedStage -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}

Invoke-GCloud @(
    "run", "deploy", $WebService,
    "--source", (Join-Path $repoRoot "frontend"),
    "--project", $ProjectId,
    "--region", $Region,
    "--platform", "managed",
    "--allow-unauthenticated",
    "--port", "8080",
    "--memory", "256Mi",
    "--cpu", "1",
    "--quiet"
)
$webUrl = (& gcloud run services describe $WebService --project $ProjectId --region $Region --format "value(status.url)").Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $webUrl) { throw "Could not read the deployed web URL." }

Invoke-GCloud @("run", "services", "update", $ApiService, "--project", $ProjectId, "--region", $Region, "--update-env-vars", "CORS_ORIGINS=$webUrl")

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Cloud Run deployment complete."
Write-Host "Web: $webUrl"
Write-Host "API: $apiUrl"
Write-Host "API readiness: $apiUrl/api/ready"
Write-Host "Check that the Cloud Run runtime service account can use Firestore in $firebaseProjectId and BigQuery/Vertex AI in $dataProjectId."



========== FILE: deploy\README.md ==========

# Cloud Run deployment

This project deploys as two Cloud Run services: the FastAPI API and the React static application. The deployment script uses Cloud Build from the Dockerfiles and keeps the local Firebase web configuration in ignored `frontend/.env`.

## Prerequisites

1. Install Google Cloud CLI, Node.js 20+, and npm.
2. Sign in with `gcloud auth login` and use an account allowed to deploy Cloud Run services, use Cloud Build and Artifact Registry, and enable APIs in the target project.
3. Configure `frontend/.env` using `frontend/.env.example`. Do not commit this file. Set the Firebase web app values for the Firebase project already used by the application.
4. Configure `backend/.env` with the GCP project that owns the existing BigQuery dataset, Vertex AI access, and optional GCS trial data. The script reads `GCP_PROJECT` from this ignored file; it defaults to the Cloud Run project if absent.

## Deploy

From the repository root in PowerShell:

```powershell
./deploy/deploy-cloud-run.ps1
```

The default Cloud Run target is `quiet-terminal-422106` in `us-central1`. Override the project, region, service names, and runtime service account as needed:

```powershell
./deploy/deploy-cloud-run.ps1 -ProjectId "your-cloud-run-project" -Region "us-central1" -RuntimeServiceAccount "clinical-trial-runtime@your-cloud-run-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

The script deploys the API first, builds the frontend with that API URL, deploys the web service, then sets API CORS to the web service origin. Both services are internet reachable so users can load the UI and Firebase-authenticated requests can reach the API. Protected API endpoints still verify Firebase ID tokens.

## Runtime identity permissions

Cloud Run uses its runtime service account and Application Default Credentials; do not upload a service-account key. Grant the runtime identity only the roles needed for configured services:

- Firestore access in the Firebase project used by `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` (typically `roles/datastore.user`).
- BigQuery job execution and read access to the configured dataset (typically `roles/bigquery.jobUser` and dataset-level `roles/bigquery.dataViewer`).
- Vertex AI model access in the project configured by `GCP_PROJECT` (typically `roles/aiplatform.user`).
- `roles/storage.objectViewer` on the trial-data bucket only when `GCS_BUCKET` is configured.

If Firebase, BigQuery, Vertex AI, or GCS belongs to another project, grant access on that resource's project. Keep `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` and `GCP_PROJECT` set to the projects that own those resources; they do not have to match the Cloud Run deployment project.

After deployment, open the printed web URL and check the printed `/api/ready` URL. Read API logs with:

```powershell
gcloud run services logs read clinical-trial-api --project quiet-terminal-422106 --region us-central1
```

# Clinical Trial RAG: File Flow and Responsibilities

This guide follows a request from the user's browser through the backend and cloud services, then maps the main files to their jobs. It describes the current repository implementation.

## 1. System at a glance

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    User[Clinical technician] --> Browser
    subgraph Frontend[React frontend]
        Browser[main.jsx mounts app] --> Auth[AuthContext and AuthScreen]
        Auth --> App[App.jsx workspace]
        App --> Hook[useSessionManager]
        App --> API[api.js authenticated HTTP client]
        Hook --> API
        API --> Views[Results, assessment, and chat components]
    end
    API -->|HTTPS + Firebase ID token| FastAPI[backend/app/main.py]
    subgraph Backend[FastAPI backend]
        FastAPI --> AuthCheck[auth_dependency.py]
        AuthCheck --> Token[firebase_auth.py]
        FastAPI --> Routes[schemas.py request and response validation]
        FastAPI --> Pipeline[pipeline.py input checks and urgent screen]
        Pipeline --> Workflow[agents/workflow.py orchestration]
        Workflow --> Tasks[agents/tasks.py model task instructions]
        Tasks --> Runtime[agents/adk_runtime.py structured model calls]
        Workflow --> Retriever[services/retriever.py]
        Retriever --> Embed[services/embeddings.py]
        Workflow --> Judge[services/eligibility_judge.py evidence checks and verdict]
        FastAPI --> UserData[services/user_data.py]
        FastAPI --> Chat[services/chat.py]
        Workflow --> TrialStore[services/trial_store.py]
    end
    Token --> Firebase[Firebase Authentication]
    UserData --> Firestore[(Cloud Firestore: user sessions and chat)]
    Embed --> Vertex[Vertex AI embeddings]
    Retriever --> BigQuery[(BigQuery: trial chunks and vectors)]
    Runtime --> Gemini[Gemini through Google ADK]
    TrialStore --> Files[Processed JSON files]
    TrialStore -. optional copy .-> GCS[Cloud Storage]
```

## 2. What happens when a user searches

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor Technician
    participant UI as App.jsx
    participant Hook as useSessionManager.js
    participant Client as api.js
    participant Route as main.py
    participant Auth as auth_dependency.py / firebase_auth.py
    participant Store as user_data.py / Firestore
    participant Pipe as pipeline.py
    participant Flow as agents/workflow.py
    participant Search as retriever.py / embeddings.py / BigQuery
    participant AI as tasks.py / adk_runtime.py / Gemini
    participant Judge as eligibility_judge.py

    Technician->>UI: Enter a de-identified case and submit
    UI->>Hook: Select or create a session
    UI->>Client: matchPatient(case, sessionId)
    Client->>Client: Add Firebase ID token
    Client->>Route: POST /api/match
    Route->>Auth: Verify token and obtain UID
    Route->>Store: Check session ownership; save query
    Route->>Pipe: Validate case and screen urgent phrases
    Pipe->>Flow: Start matching if screening allows it
    Flow->>AI: Extract supported patient facts
    AI-->>Flow: Structured profile
    Flow->>Search: Retrieve candidate trial chunks
    Search-->>Flow: Ranked trial candidates
    opt No candidate or weak retrieval
        Flow->>AI: Propose one profile-grounded refinement
        Flow->>Search: Run at most one additional retrieval
        Search-->>Flow: Merge and deduplicate candidates
    end
    loop For shortlisted candidates (bounded)
        Flow->>AI: Assess trial criteria using supplied record text
        AI-->>Flow: Proposed criteria, quotes, and explanations
        Flow->>Judge: Verify evidence and compute conservative verdict
    end
    Flow-->>Route: Structured result and evidence
    Route->>Store: Save result under the user's session
    Route-->>Client: Match response with session ID
    Client-->>UI: Display results and clinical assessment
```

## 5. Trial data ingestion files

This is an offline preparation path. It does not run for each user search.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Fetch[fetch_trials.py<br/>Fetch and normalize trial records] --> Trials[processed/trials.json]
    FetchPMC[fetch_pmc.py<br/>Optional publication enrichment] -. optional .-> Trials
    Trials --> Chunk[chunker.py<br/>Split overview and criteria text]
    Chunk --> Build[build_index.py<br/>Prepare/validate processed index]
    Chunk --> Ingest[ingest.py<br/>Embed, validate, and load new chunks]
    Ingest --> Emb[services/embeddings.py]
    Emb --> Vertex[Vertex AI]
    Ingest --> BQ[(BigQuery trial_chunks)]
    Ingest -. optional upload .-> GCS[(Cloud Storage)]
```

|---|---|

| `backend/ingestion/fetch_pmc.py` | Optional collection/enrichment from PubMed Central. |
| `backend/ingestion/chunker.py` | Splits trial records into retrieval-friendly text chunks. |
| `backend/ingestion/build_index.py` | Builds or validates local processed data/index inputs. |
| `backend/ingestion/ingest.py` | Creates embeddings, validates records, and loads chunks to BigQuery; optionally writes processed JSON to GCS. |
| `backend/sql/init_bigquery.sql`, `verify_bigquery.sql` | BigQuery setup and verification queries. |
| `backend/data/processed/trials.json`, `chunks.json` | Processed local trial records and chunk cache/fallback data. |

| Change service configuration/deployment | `backend/app/config.py`, `.env.example`, Dockerfiles, and `deploy/` files |

The workflow provides preliminary research support. Trial evidence and criteria should remain visible so a qualified clinical team can independently review the official record.

========== FILE: frontend\src\api.js ==========

/**
 * API service for communicating with the FastAPI backend.
 */

import { auth } from "./firebase";

export const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "";

/**
 * @typedef {Object} MatchResponse
 * @property {Object} patient_profile
 * @property {Array<Object>} matches
 * @property {string} disclaimer
 * @property {number} latency_seconds
 * @property {string|null} [emergency_notice] Present when urgent screening stops matching.
 * @property {string[]} [missing_key_facts] Plain-language facts absent from the validated profile.
 * @property {string[]} [conflicting_facts] Conflicts detected in supported case text.
 * @property {Array<{nct_id: string, title: string, reason: string}>} [ruled_out_trials]
 * @property {string|null} [result_message] Search-specific empty-state explanation.
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} ChatResponse
 * @property {string} answer
 * @property {Array<Object>} citations
 * @property {string|null} missing_info
 * @property {string|null} session_id Client-provided identifier; not server-side memory.
 */

async function request(endpoint, options = {}) {
  let response;

  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
      ...options,
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        ...(auth?.currentUser
          ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${await auth.currentUser.getIdToken()}` }
          : {}),
        ...options.headers,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(
      "Cannot connect to the backend server. Please verify that FastAPI is running on http://localhost:8000."
    );
  }

  const raw = await response.text();
  let data;

  try {
    data = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      `The server returned an invalid response: ${raw.slice(0, 200)}`
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = data?.detail || data?.message || raw;
    throw new Error(
      typeof detail === "string" ? detail : JSON.stringify(detail)
    );
  }

  return data;
}

/**
 * Match a de-identified patient case against clinical trials.
 * @param {string} patientCase
 * @returns {Promise<MatchResponse>}
 */
export async function matchPatient(patientCase, sessionId) {
  if (!patientCase || !patientCase.trim()) {
    throw new Error("Please enter a patient case before matching trials.");
  }

  return request("/api/match", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({
      patient_case: patientCase.trim(),
      session_id: sessionId || null,
    }),
  });
}

/**
 * Ask a follow-up question grounded strictly in the retrieved trials.
 * @param {Object} params
 * @param {string} params.question
 * @param {Array<string>} params.trialIds
 * @param {string} [params.patientCase]
 * @param {string} [params.sessionId]
 * @returns {Promise<ChatResponse>}
 */
export async function askTrialQuestion({
  question,
  trialIds,
  patientCase = null,
  sessionId = null,
  messageId = null,
}) {
  if (!question || !question.trim()) {
    throw new Error("Please enter a question.");
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(trialIds) || trialIds.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("At least one trial ID is required for Q&A.");
  }

  return request("/api/trials/chat", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({
      question: question.trim(),
      trial_ids: trialIds,
      session_id: sessionId || null,
      message_id: messageId || null,
    }),
  });
}

/**
 * Check backend health & trial indexing status.
 * @returns {Promise<{status: string, trials_indexed?: number}>}
 */
export async function checkHealth() {
  try {
    return await request("/api/health", { method: "GET" });
  } catch {
    return { status: "offline", trials_indexed: 0 };
  }
}

export async function initializeProfile(displayName) {
  return request("/api/auth/profile", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ display_name: displayName }),
  });
}

export async function listSessions() {
  return request("/api/sessions", { method: "GET" });
}

export async function createSession(title = "New Patient Session") {
  return request("/api/sessions", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ title }),
  });
}

export async function getSession(sessionId) {
  return request(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`, { method: "GET" });
}

export async function renameRemoteSession(sessionId, title) {
  return request(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`, {
    method: "PATCH",
    body: JSON.stringify({ title }),
  });
}

export async function deleteRemoteSession(sessionId) {
  return request(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

export async function clearRemoteSessions() {
  return request("/api/sessions", { method: "DELETE" });
}

export async function clearRemoteChat(sessionId) {
  return request(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}/messages`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

export async function clearRemoteResult(sessionId) {
  return request(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}/result`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

export default {
  matchPatient,
  askTrialQuestion,
  checkHealth,
  initializeProfile,
  listSessions,
  createSession,
  getSession,
  renameRemoteSession,
  deleteRemoteSession,
  clearRemoteSessions,
  clearRemoteChat,
  clearRemoteResult,
};

function ClinicalWorkspace({ authUser, onLogout }) {
  const displayName = (
    authUser.profile.displayName
    || authUser.firebaseUser.displayName
    || authUser.firebaseUser.email?.split("@")[0]
    || "Clinical Technician"
  ).trim();
  const {
    sessions,
    activeSessionId,
    activeSession,
    switchSession,
    createNewSession,

    updateActiveSession,
    renameSession,

    clearAllSessions,
    loading: sessionsLoading,

    error: sessionsError,
  } = useSessionManager(authUser);

  const { toast, showToast, hideToast } = useToast();

  // Local state bound to active session
  const [patientText, setPatientText] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [isSidebarOpen, setIsSidebarOpen] = useState(() => (
    typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia("(min-width: 1024px)").matches
  ));
  const [isChatOpen, setIsChatOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAssessmentPageOpen, setIsAssessmentPageOpen] = useState(false);
  const [healthStatus, setHealthStatus] = useState("checking");
  const [trialCount, setTrialCount] = useState(0);

  const resultsRef = useRef(null);
  const patientInputRef = useRef(null);

  const handleStartSearch = () => {
    patientInputRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
    window.setTimeout(() => patientInputRef.current?.focus(), 250);
  };

  const handleOpenAssessment = () => {
    if (!activeSession?.data) return;
    setIsChatOpen(false);
    setIsAssessmentPageOpen(true);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  const handleBackToResults = () => {
    setIsAssessmentPageOpen(false);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      resultsRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }, 0);
  };

  // Sync local text input when active session changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSession) {
      setPatientText(activeSession.patientCase || "");
      setError("");
      setIsAssessmentPageOpen(false);
    }
  }, [activeSession?.id, activeSession?.patientCase]);

  // Check backend health on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    checkHealth()
      .then((res) => {
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (res && res.status === "ok") {
          setHealthStatus("online");
          if (Number.isFinite(res.trials_indexed)) setTrialCount(res.trials_indexed);
        } else {
          setHealthStatus("offline");
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (mounted) setHealthStatus("offline");
      });

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Step ticker animation during loading
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading) {
      setMatchStep(0);
      return undefined;
    }

    setMatchStep(0);
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setMatchStep((prev) => Math.min(prev + 1, MATCH_STEPS.length - 1));
    }, 4500);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [loading]);

  // Handle case submission
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    const cleanCase = patientText.trim();
    if (cleanCase.length < 40 || loading) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      if (!activeSessionId || !activeSession) throw new Error("Your session is still loading. Please try again.");
      let searchSession = activeSession;
      if (activeSession.data) {
        const title = `Trial search Â· ${new Date().toLocaleString([], { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" })}`;
        searchSession = await createNewSession(title);
      }
      updateSession(searchSession.id, { patientCase: cleanCase, touch: true });
      const result = await matchPatient(cleanCase, searchSession.id);

      if (!result || !Array.isArray(result.matches)) {
        throw new Error("Invalid response format received from matching service.");
      }

      updateSession(searchSession.id, {
        patientCase: cleanCase,
        data: result,
        activeTab: 0,
      });

      showToast(
        `Retrieved and evaluated ${result.matches.length} candidate trials`,
        "success"
      );

      // Smooth scroll to results
      setTimeout(() => {
        resultsRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: "smooth",
          block: "start",
        });
      }, 150);
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.message || "Failed to match clinical trials.";
      setError(msg);
      showToast(msg, "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTextChange = (e) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setPatientText(val);
    updateActiveSession({ patientCase: val });
  };

  const handleLoadSample = () => {
    setPatientText(SAMPLE_CASE);
    updateActiveSession({ patientCase: SAMPLE_CASE });
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      patientInputRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
      patientInputRef.current?.focus();
    }, 0);
    showToast("Loaded sample NSCLC clinical case", "info");
  };

  const handleClearCase = async () => {
    setPatientText("");
    if (activeSessionId) {
      try {
        await clearRemoteResult(activeSessionId);
      } catch (clearError) {
        showToast(clearError.message || "Could not clear the saved result.", "error");
      }
    }
    updateActiveSession({ patientCase: "", data: null });
  };

  const handleSelectTab = (index) => {
    updateActiveSession({ activeTab: index });
  };

  const handleUpdateChatHistory = (newHistory) => {
    updateActiveSession({ chatHistory: newHistory });
  };

  const handleCopySummary = () => {
    if (!activeSession?.data?.matches) return;
    const matches = activeSession.data.matches;
    const lines = [
      `Clinical Trial Match Summary (${matches.length} candidate trials)`,
      `Session: ${activeSession.title}`,
      `Date: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}`,
      "",
      ...matches.map(
        (m, i) =>
          `#${i + 1} [${m.verdict}] ${m.nct_id}: ${m.title} (Match: ${Math.round(
            (m.relevance_score || 0) * 100
          )}%)`
      ),
    ];
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(lines.join("\n")).catch(() => {});
    showToast("Summary copied to clipboard", "success");
  };

  const currentData = activeSession?.data || null;
  const currentMatches = currentData?.matches || [];
  const currentActiveTab = Math.min(
    activeSession?.activeTab || 0,
    Math.max(0, currentMatches.length - 1)
  );
  const selectedMatch = currentMatches[currentActiveTab] || null;

  return (
    <AppShell
      isSidebarOpen={isSidebarOpen}
      header={
        <Header
          healthStatus={healthStatus}
          trialCount={trialCount}
          sessionCount={sessions.length}
          isSidebarOpen={isSidebarOpen}
          onToggleSidebar={() => setIsSidebarOpen(!isSidebarOpen)}
          onNewSession={() => {
            createNewSession()
              .then(() => showToast("Started a new patient matching session", "info"))
              .catch((err) => showToast(err.message || "Could not start a session.", "error"));
          }}
          hasAssessment={Boolean(currentData) && !isAssessmentPageOpen}
          onOpenAssessment={handleOpenAssessment}
          displayName={displayName}
          onLogout={onLogout}
        />
      }
      sidebar={
        <SessionSidebar
          isOpen={isSidebarOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsSidebarOpen(false)}
          sessions={sessions}
          activeSessionId={activeSessionId}
          onSelectSession={(id) => {
            switchSession(id).then((opened) => {
              if (opened) showToast("Loaded session", "info");
            });
          }}
          onNewSession={() => {
            createNewSession()
              .then(() => showToast("Started a new session", "info"))
              .catch((err) => showToast(err.message || "Could not start a session.", "error"));
          }}
          onRenameSession={(id, title) => {
            renameSession(id, title);
            showToast("Session renamed", "success");
          }}
          onDeleteSession={(id) => {
            deleteSession(id);
            showToast("Session removed", "info");
          }}
          onClearAllSessions={() => {
            clearAllSessions();
            showToast("All sessions cleared", "info");
          }}
        />
      }
      footer={<Footer />}
    >
      {/* â”€â”€ Main Input Card â”€â”€ */}
      {isAssessmentPageOpen && currentData ? (
        <ClinicalAssessmentPage
          data={currentData}
          patientCase={patientText}
          sessionTitle={activeSession?.title}
          onBack={handleBackToResults}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
      <WorkspaceWelcome
        displayName={displayName}
        healthStatus={healthStatus}
        trialCount={trialCount}
        sessionCount={sessions.length}
        recentSessions={sessions}
        onOpenSession={(id) => switchSession(id)}
        onStartSearch={handleStartSearch}
        onLoadSample={handleLoadSample}
        actionsDisabled={sessionsLoading}
      />

      <section className="input-panel-section">
        {(sessionsLoading || loadingSessionId) && <div className="session-loading-note" role="status">{loadingSessionId ? "Opening your saved sessionâ€¦" : "Loading your secure sessionsâ€¦"}</div>}
        {sessionsError && <div className="auth-alert" role="alert">{sessionsError}</div>}
        <div className="section-header-row">
          <div>
            <span className="section-eyebrow">PATIENT CASE INTAKE</span>
            <h2 className="section-heading">Clinical Narrative Analysis</h2>
            <p className="section-subtext">
              Enter an anonymized clinical note (age, sex, histology, stage, biomarkers, prior therapies, comorbidities, and laboratory values).
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="input-quick-actions">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleLoadSample}
              icon="ðŸ“„"
              title="Load sample stage IIIB NSCLC case"
            >
              Use Sample Case
            </Button>
            {(patientText || currentData) && (
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleClearCase}
                title="Clear patient input"
              >
                Clear
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="case-input-form">
          <div className="textarea-wrapper">
            <textarea
              ref={patientInputRef}
              className="patient-textarea"
              value={patientText}
              onChange={handleTextChange}
              placeholder="Paste anonymized patient summary: e.g. 62-year-old woman with stage IIIB non-small cell lung cancer, EGFR exon 19 deletion positive, ECOG 1, prior metformin for diabetes, normal renal function..."
              rows={5}
              disabled={loading}
              aria-label="Anonymized patient case"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="input-action-bar">
            <div className="char-indicator">
              <span
                className={`char-count-pill ${
                  patientText.trim().length >= 40 ? "char-valid" : "char-insufficient"
                }`}
              >
                {patientText.trim().length} characters
              </span>
              <span className="char-min-note">
                {patientText.trim().length < 40
                  ? `(minimum 40 characters required, ${40 - patientText.trim().length} more needed)`
                  : "âœ“ Ready for trial matching"}
              </span>
            </div>

            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="lg"
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading || sessionsLoading || !activeSessionId || patientText.trim().length < 40}
              loading={loading}
              icon="ðŸ”"
              title="Run vector retrieval and Gemini eligibility judge"
            >
              {loading ? "Matching Trials..." : "Find Matching Trials"}
            </Button>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div className="error-banner" role="alert">
              <span className="error-icon">âš </span>
              <span className="error-text">{error}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </form>
      </section>

      {/* â”€â”€ Stepped Loading State â”€â”€ */}
      {loading && (
        <section className="loading-state-panel" aria-live="polite">
          <div className="loading-card">
            <div className="loading-header">
              <div className="loading-spinner-orbit" />
              <div>
                <h3 className="loading-title">Matching Patient Case</h3>
                <p className="loading-subtitle">
                  Retrieving candidate trials from BigQuery and evaluating criteria against documented patient facts.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="steps-progress-list">
              {MATCH_STEPS.map((step, idx) => {
                const isDone = idx < matchStep;
                const isCurrent = idx === matchStep;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={idx}
                    className={`step-item ${isDone ? "step-done" : isCurrent ? "step-current" : "step-pending"}`}
                  >
                    <div className="step-circle">
                      {isDone ? "âœ“" : isCurrent ? <span className="step-pulse" /> : idx + 1}
                    </div>
                    <span className="step-label">{step}</span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Shimmer skeleton placeholders */}
          <div className="skeleton-grid">
            <SkeletonCard />
            <SkeletonCard />
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ Empty State â”€â”€ */}
      {!loading && !currentData && (
        <section className="empty-state-panel">
          <div className="empty-state-card">
            <div className="empty-illustration">ðŸ”¬</div>
            <h3 className="empty-title">A clear path from case details to trial evidence</h3>
            <p className="empty-description">
              Add an anonymized clinical summary above. Your shortlist will include sourced eligibility evidence to support a careful review.
            </p>

            <div className="empty-features-grid">
              <div className="feature-pill">
                <span className="feature-icon">âš¡</span>
                <div>
                  <strong>Start with clinical context</strong>
                  <p>Include diagnosis, stage, biomarkers, and prior treatment when available.</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="feature-pill">
                <span className="feature-icon">ðŸ›¡ï¸</span>
                <div>
                  <strong>Review eligibility evidence</strong>
                  <p>Compare inclusion and exclusion criteria with the documented case facts.</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="feature-pill">
                <span className="feature-icon">ðŸ’¬</span>
                <div>
                  <strong>Continue the discussion</strong>
                  <p>Ask follow-up questions using the evidence from your selected studies.</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ Results Area â”€â”€ */}
      {!loading && currentData && (
        <section className="results-container-section" ref={resultsRef}>
          {(currentData.emergency_notice ||
            currentData.missing_key_facts?.length > 0 ||
            currentData.conflicting_facts?.length > 0) && (
            <div className={`result-safety-notice ${currentData.emergency_notice ? "result-safety-urgent" : ""}`} role={currentData.emergency_notice ? "alert" : "status"}>
              {currentData.emergency_notice && (
                <section>
                  <h3>Urgent safety notice</h3>
                  <p>{currentData.emergency_notice}</p>
                </section>
              )}
              {currentData.conflicting_facts?.length > 0 && (
                <section>
                  <h3>Conflicting information to review</h3>
                  <ul>{currentData.conflicting_facts.map((item, index) => <li key={`conflict-${index}`}>{item}</li>)}</ul>
                </section>
              )}
              {currentData.missing_key_facts?.length > 0 && (
                <section>
                  <h3>Information not provided</h3>
                  <ul>{currentData.missing_key_facts.map((item, index) => <li key={`missing-${index}`}>{item}</li>)}</ul>
                </section>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Summary Metric Bar */}
          <ResultsOverview
            data={currentData}
            onCopySummary={currentMatches.length > 0 ? handleCopySummary : undefined}
            onOpenChat={currentMatches.length > 0 ? () => setIsChatOpen(true) : undefined}
          />

          {/* Extracted Patient Profile */}
          <details className="patient-profile-disclosure">
            <summary>View extracted patient profile</summary>
            <PatientProfileCard
              profile={currentData.patient_profile}
              patientCase={patientText}
            />
          </details>

          {/* Top Trial Shortlist */}
          {currentMatches.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="matches-wrapper">
              <div className="shortlist-header">
                <div>
                  <span className="section-eyebrow">TRIAL SHORTLIST</span>
                  <h3 className="shortlist-title">Candidate Clinical Trials</h3>
                  <p className="shortlist-subtitle">
                    Available non-excluded candidates. Select a trial to review its criterion evidence and citations.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Top 3 Tab Switcher */}
              <TrialTabs
                matches={currentMatches}
                activeTab={currentActiveTab}
                onSelectTab={handleSelectTab}
              />

              {/* Selected Trial Deep-Dive */}
              {selectedMatch && (
                <TrialDetailView
                  match={selectedMatch}
                  onOpenChat={() => setIsChatOpen(true)}
                  onCopyNotice={(msg) => showToast(msg, "success")}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="no-matches-card">
              <h4>{currentData.result_message || "No suitable trial was found in this search"}</h4>
              <p>
                Review any missing or conflicting information and consult a qualified clinical team. This result applies only to the trials found in this search.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Regulatory & Safety Disclaimer */}
          <div className="safety-disclaimer-box">
            <span className="disclaimer-icon">â“˜</span>
            <p className="disclaimer-text">
              {currentData.disclaimer ||
                "Clinical Trial Matcher is a research decision-support tool. It does not provide medical diagnoses or treatment recommendations. Eligibility must always be validated by qualified clinical investigators and study sponsors."}
            </p>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ Slide-over Chat Drawer â”€â”€ */}
        </>
      )}

      <ChatDrawer
        isOpen={isChatOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsChatOpen(false)}
        trialIds={currentMatches.map((m) => m.nct_id).filter(Boolean)}
        trialTitles={currentMatches.map((m) => ({ id: m.nct_id, title: m.title }))}
        patientCase={patientText}
        sessionId={activeSessionId}
        chatHistory={activeSession?.chatHistory || []}
        onUpdateHistory={handleUpdateChatHistory}
        onShowToast={showToast}
      />

      {/* â”€â”€ Floating Toast â”€â”€ */}
      <Toast toast={toast} onDismiss={hideToast} />
    </AppShell>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  const { user, loading, signOut } = useAuth();
  if (loading) {
    return <main className="auth-page"><div className="auth-loading" role="status">Loading secure workspaceâ€¦</div></main>;
  }
  if (!user) return <AuthScreen />;
  return (
    <ClinicalWorkspace
      key={user.firebaseUser.uid}
      authUser={user}
      onLogout={async () => { await signOut(); }}
    />
  );
}

  projectId: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,
  appId: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID,
};

export const isFirebaseConfigured = Object.values(config).every(Boolean);
export const firebaseApp = isFirebaseConfigured ? initializeApp(config) : null;
export const auth = firebaseApp ? getAuth(firebaseApp) : null;

========== FILE: frontend\src\auth\AuthContext.jsx ==========

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword,
  onAuthStateChanged,
  sendPasswordResetEmail,
  signInWithEmailAndPassword,
  signOut,
  updateProfile,
} from "firebase/auth";
import { API_BASE, initializeProfile } from "../api";
import { auth, isFirebaseConfigured } from "../firebase";

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

async function loadProfile(firebaseUser) {
  const token = await firebaseUser.getIdToken();
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/profile`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(response.status === 503
      ? "User profile storage is unavailable. Check Firebase Admin and Firestore setup."
      : "Could not load your user profile. Please retry sign-in.");
  }
  return response.json();
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!auth) {
      setLoading(false);
      return undefined;
    }
    let mounted = true;
    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (firebaseUser) => {
      setUser(null);
      setError("");
      if (!firebaseUser) {
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const profile = await loadProfile(firebaseUser);
        if (mounted) setUser({ firebaseUser, profile });
      } catch (loadError) {
        if (mounted) setError(loadError.message || "Could not load your profile.");
      } finally {
        if (mounted) setLoading(false);
      }
    });
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({
    user,
    loading,
    error,
    configured: isFirebaseConfigured,
    signIn: (email, password) => signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password),
    sendPasswordReset: (email) => sendPasswordResetEmail(auth, email),
    signUp: async (displayName, email, password) => {
      const credential = await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
      await updateProfile(credential.user, { displayName });
      await credential.user.getIdToken(true);
      const profile = await initializeProfile(displayName);
      setUser({ firebaseUser: credential.user, profile });
      return credential;
    },
    signOut: () => signOut(auth),
    retryProfile: async () => {
      if (!auth?.currentUser) return;
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");
      try {
        const profile = await loadProfile(auth.currentUser);
        setUser({ firebaseUser: auth.currentUser, profile });
      } catch (loadError) {
        setError(loadError.message || "Could not load your profile.");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
  }), [user, loading, error]);

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth() {
  const value = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!value) throw new Error("useAuth must be used within AuthProvider.");
  return value;
}

import React, { useState } from "react";

function readableAuthError(error) {
  const code = error?.code || "";
  const messages = {
    "auth/email-already-in-use": "An account already exists for this email.",
    "auth/invalid-email": "Enter a valid email address.",
    "auth/invalid-credential": "Email or password is incorrect.",
    "auth/user-disabled": "This account is disabled. Contact your application support team.",
    "auth/weak-password": "Use a password with at least 6 characters.",
    "auth/too-many-requests": "Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.",
    "auth/network-request-failed": "Network error. Check your connection and retry.",
  };
  return messages[code] || error?.message || "Authentication failed. Please try again.";
}

function readableResetError(error) {
  const code = error?.code || "";
  const messages = {
    "auth/invalid-email": "Enter a valid email address to reset your password.",
    "auth/too-many-requests": "Too many reset attempts. Wait a moment and try again.",
    "auth/network-request-failed": "Network error. Check your connection and retry.",
  };
  return messages[code] || "We could not send the reset email. Please try again.";
}

            </span>
            <span>Clinical Trial Matcher</span>
          </div>
          <div className="auth-artwork-wrap"><MedicalArtwork className="auth-medical-artwork" /></div>
          <div className="auth-visual-copy">
            <span className="auth-visual-kicker"><i /> RESEARCH WORKSPACE</span>

            <p>Explore trial criteria and source evidence in one secure workspace for clinical research teams.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="auth-visual-footer"><span aria-hidden="true">âœš</span> Built for clinical research review</div>

              {busy ? "Please waitâ€¦" : isSignup ? "Create account" : "Sign in"}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import Button from "../ui/Button";
import { askTrialQuestion, clearRemoteChat } from "../../api";
import { deduplicateCitations } from "../../utils/deduplication";
import Icon from "../ui/Icon";

const SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS = [
  "Why might this patient be excluded from these trials?",
  "Compare the age and biomarker criteria across all 3 trials",
  "Which trial has the most lenient inclusion criteria?",
  "What information is missing from the case to confirm eligibility?",
];

/**
 * Format markdown-like text (headings, bold, lists) cleanly without raw syntax.
 */
function FormattedMessage({ text }) {
  if (!text) return null;

  const lines = text.split("\n");
  const elements = [];
  let currentList = [];

  const flushList = () => {
    if (currentList.length > 0) {
      elements.push(
        <ul className="chat-bullet-list" key={`list-${elements.length}`}>
          {currentList.map((item, idx) => (
            <li key={idx}>{renderInline(item)}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      );
      currentList = [];
    }
  };

  const renderInline = (str) => {
    const parts = str.split(/(\*\*.*?\*\*)/g);
    return parts.map((part, i) => {
      if (part.startsWith("**") && part.endsWith("**")) {
        return <strong key={i}>{part.slice(2, -2)}</strong>;
      }
      return part;
    });
  };

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i].trim();

    if (!line) {
      flushList();
      continue;
    }

    if (line.startsWith("### ") || line.startsWith("## ")) {
      flushList();
      const heading = line.replace(/^#{2,3}\s+/, "");
      elements.push(
        <h4 className="chat-msg-heading" key={`h-${i}`}>
          {renderInline(heading)}
        </h4>
      );
      continue;
    }

    if (line.startsWith("* ") || line.startsWith("- ")) {
      currentList.push(line.slice(2));
      continue;
    }

    if (/^\d+\.\s+/.test(line)) {
      currentList.push(line.replace(/^\d+\.\s+/, ""));
      continue;
    }

    flushList();
    elements.push(
      <p className="chat-msg-p" key={`p-${i}`}>
        {renderInline(line)}
      </p>
    );
  }

  flushList();
  return <div className="chat-formatted-body">{elements}</div>;
}

/**
 * Slide-over Chat Drawer for evidence-grounded trial Q&A.
 */
export default function ChatDrawer({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  trialIds = [],
  trialTitles = [],
  patientCase = "",
  sessionId = "",
  chatHistory = [],
  onUpdateHistory,
  onShowToast,
}) {
  const [question, setQuestion] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [copiedIndex, setCopiedIndex] = useState(null);

  const historyEndRef = useRef(null);
  const inputRef = useRef(null);

  // Focus input and scroll to bottom on open or new messages
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      inputRef.current?.focus();
      historyEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  }, [isOpen, chatHistory, loading]);

  // Handle Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return undefined;
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const handleSend = async (questionText) => {
    const q = (questionText || question).trim();
    if (!q || loading) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const messageId = globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.()
        || `turn_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
      const data = await askTrialQuestion({
        question: q,
        trialIds,
        patientCase,
        sessionId,
        messageId,
      });

      const newTurn = {
        question: q,
        answer: data.answer || "No response was returned.",
        citations: Array.isArray(data.citations)
          ? deduplicateCitations(data.citations)
          : [],
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      const updated = [...chatHistory, newTurn];
      onUpdateHistory(updated);
      setQuestion("");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Failed to retrieve an answer.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSend();
    }
  };

  const handleCopyAnswer = (answerText, index) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(answerText).catch(() => {});
    setCopiedIndex(index);
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast("Answer copied to clipboard", "success");
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedIndex(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleClearHistory = async () => {
    if (chatHistory.length > 0) {
      try {
        await clearRemoteChat(sessionId);
        onUpdateHistory([]);
        if (onShowToast) onShowToast("Chat conversation cleared", "info");
      } catch (clearError) {
        setError(clearError?.message || "Could not clear saved chat history.");
      }
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="chat-drawer-overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="chat-drawer-title">
      <div className="chat-drawer-backdrop" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />

      <aside className="chat-drawer-panel">
        {/* â”€â”€ Header â”€â”€ */}
        <div className="chat-drawer-header">
          <div className="chat-header-title-group">
            <div className="chat-avatar-icon"><Icon name="chat" size={18} /></div>
            <div>
              <h3 id="chat-drawer-title" className="chat-drawer-title">
                Trial Research Assistant
              </h3>
              <p className="chat-drawer-subtitle">
                Grounded strictly in the {trialIds.length} candidate trial{trialIds.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="chat-header-actions">
            {chatHistory.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="chat-clear-btn"
                onClick={handleClearHistory}
                title="Clear chat history"
              >
                Clear
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              className="chat-close-btn"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Close assistant"
            >
              âœ•
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* â”€â”€ Context trial pills â”€â”€ */}
        <div className="chat-context-strip">
          <span className="context-label">TRIAL CONTEXT:</span>
          <div className="context-pills">
            {trialTitles.length > 0 ? (
              trialTitles.map((t) => (
                <span key={t.id} className="context-pill" title={t.title}>
                  {t.id}
                </span>
              ))
            ) : trialIds.length > 0 ? (
              trialIds.map((id) => (
                <span key={id} className="context-pill">
                  {id}
                </span>
              ))
            ) : (
              <span className="context-pill text-muted">No trials selected</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* â”€â”€ Conversation History â”€â”€ */}
        <div className="chat-history-container" aria-live="polite">
          {chatHistory.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="chat-welcome-state">
              <div className="welcome-icon"><Icon name="sparkle" size={20} /></div>
              <h4 className="welcome-title">Ask follow-up questions</h4>
              <p className="welcome-desc">
                Ask specific questions regarding inclusion, exclusion criteria, disease stage, previous therapies, or how the candidate trials compare.
              </p>

              <div className="suggestions-label">SUGGESTED QUESTIONS:</div>
              <div className="suggestions-list">
                {SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS.map((sug, i) => (
                  <button
                    key={i}
                    type="button"
                    className="suggestion-pill"
                    onClick={() => handleSend(sug)}
                    disabled={loading}
                  >
                    <span>{sug}</span>
                    <span className="suggestion-arrow">â†—</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            chatHistory.map((turn, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="chat-turn">
                {/* User question bubble */}
                <div className="chat-question-row">
                  <div className="user-bubble">
                    <p className="user-text">{turn.question}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Assistant response card */}
                <div className="chat-answer-row">
                  <div className="assistant-card">
                    <div className="assistant-card-header">
                      <div className="assistant-label">
                        <span className="assistant-icon"><Icon name="sparkle" size={14} /></span>
                        <span>Clinical AI Response</span>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="copy-answer-btn"
                        onClick={() => handleCopyAnswer(turn.answer, index)}
                        title="Copy answer"
                      >
                        {copiedIndex === index ? "âœ“ Copied" : "ðŸ“‹ Copy"}
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    <div className="assistant-card-body">
                      <FormattedMessage text={turn.answer} />
                    </div>

                    {turn.citations && turn.citations.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="assistant-citations">
                        <span className="citations-heading">EVIDENCE SOURCES:</span>
                        <div className="citations-list">
                          {turn.citations.map((c, ci) => (
                            <a
                              key={ci}
                              href={c.url || `https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/${c.nct_id}`}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noopener noreferrer"
                              className="citation-badge"
                              title={c.excerpt || c.section || "Clinical study record"}
                            >
                              <span>{c.nct_id}</span>
                              {c.section && <span className="citation-section">â€¢ {c.section}</span>}
                              <span className="citation-link-icon">â†—</span>
                            </a>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}

          {loading && (
            <div className="chat-loading-row">
              <div className="chat-loading-bubble">
                <span className="chat-spinner-dot" />
                <span className="chat-spinner-dot" />
                <span className="chat-spinner-dot" />
                <span className="chat-loading-text">
                  Searching trial evidence & generating grounded answer...
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div ref={historyEndRef} />
        </div>

        {/* â”€â”€ Input bar â”€â”€ */}
        <div className="chat-input-bar">
          {error && (
            <div className="chat-error-banner" role="alert">
              <span>âš  {error}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="chat-form-row">
            <textarea
              ref={inputRef}
              className="chat-input-field"
              value={question}
              onChange={(e) => setQuestion(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
              placeholder="Ask about age limits, biomarker criteria, allowed therapies... (Ctrl+Enter to send)"
              rows={2}
              disabled={loading}
              aria-label="Question about trials"
            />

            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="md"
              onClick={() => handleSend()}
              disabled={loading || !question.trim()}
              loading={loading}
              title="Send question"
              className="chat-send-button"
            >
              Send
            </Button>
          </div>

          <div className="chat-input-hints">
            <span>Press Ctrl/âŒ˜ + Enter to send</span>
            <span>â€¢</span>
            <span>Answers use only verified trial criteria</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";

function AssessmentNotice({ data }) {
  const hasNotice = data?.emergency_notice
    || data?.missing_key_facts?.length
    || data?.conflicting_facts?.length;
  if (!hasNotice) return null;

  return (
    <section className={`result-safety-notice assessment-safety-notice ${data.emergency_notice ? "result-safety-urgent" : ""}`} role={data.emergency_notice ? "alert" : "status"}>
      {data.emergency_notice && <div><h3>Urgent safety notice</h3><p>{data.emergency_notice}</p></div>}
      {data.conflicting_facts?.length > 0 && <div><h3>Conflicting information to review</h3><ul>{data.conflicting_facts.map((item) => <li key={item}>{item}</li>)}</ul></div>}
      {data.missing_key_facts?.length > 0 && <div><h3>Information not provided</h3><ul>{data.missing_key_facts.map((item) => <li key={item}>{item}</li>)}</ul></div>}
    </section>
  );
}

export default function ClinicalAssessmentPage({ data, patientCase, sessionTitle, onBack }) {
  const matches = Array.isArray(data?.matches) ? data.matches : [];
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(matches[0]?.nct_id || "");
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("criteria");
  // Keep the selected trial when possible; fall back to the first saved result.
  const selectedMatch = matches.find((match) => match.nct_id === selectedId) || matches[0];
  const criteria = selectedMatch?.criteria || [];
  const passages = selectedMatch?.passages || [];
  const counts = countCriteria(criteria);
  const officialUrl = selectedMatch?.url || (selectedMatch?.nct_id ? `https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/${selectedMatch.nct_id}` : "");

  return (
    <section className="clinical-assessment-page" aria-labelledby="clinical-assessment-title">

          Back to trial results
        </button>
        <span className="assessment-session-label" title={sessionTitle}>{sessionTitle || "Clinical trial review"}</span>
      </div>

      <header className="assessment-page-hero">
        <div className="assessment-hero-copy">
          <span className="section-eyebrow">CLINICAL REVIEW</span>
          <h1 id="clinical-assessment-title">Clinical Assessment Summary</h1>
          <p>Review each trialâ€™s criteria, supporting patient evidence, and source passages.</p>
        </div>
      </header>

      <AssessmentNotice data={data} />

      {matches.length > 1 && (
        <nav className="assessment-trial-picker" aria-label="Choose a trial to assess">
          <span className="assessment-picker-label">TRIALS IN THIS SEARCH</span>
          <div className="assessment-trial-options">
            {matches.map((match, index) => (
              <button key={match.nct_id || index} type="button"
                className={`assessment-trial-option ${selectedMatch === match ? "is-selected" : ""}`}
                onClick={() => { setSelectedId(match.nct_id || ""); setActiveTab("criteria"); }}>
                <span className="assessment-trial-option-index">{index + 1}</span>
                <span className="assessment-trial-option-copy"><strong>{match.title || "Clinical trial"}</strong><small>{match.nct_id || "Trial ID unavailable"}</small></span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </nav>
      )}

========== FILE: frontend\src\components\results\CriteriaSection.jsx ==========

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Badge from "../ui/Badge";
import { deduplicateCriteria } from "../../utils/deduplication";

const FILTERS = [
  { id: "ALL", label: "All criteria" },
  { id: "SUPPORTS", label: "Supports trial" },
  { id: "BLOCKS", label: "Potential blocker" },
  { id: "UNKNOWN", label: "Could not assess" },
];

/** Render quote-verified criteria as a readable, filterable evidence table. */
export default function CriteriaSection({ criteria = [] }) {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const cleanCriteria = useMemo(() => deduplicateCriteria(criteria), [criteria]);
  const counts = useMemo(() => ({
    ALL: cleanCriteria.length,
    SUPPORTS: cleanCriteria.filter((item) => item.impact === "SUPPORTS").length,
    BLOCKS: cleanCriteria.filter((item) => item.impact === "BLOCKS").length,
    UNKNOWN: cleanCriteria.filter((item) => item.impact === "UNKNOWN" || !item.impact).length,
  }), [cleanCriteria]);
  const displayed = filter === "ALL"
    ? cleanCriteria
    : cleanCriteria.filter((item) => filter === "UNKNOWN"
      ? item.impact === "UNKNOWN" || !item.impact
      : item.impact === filter);

  if (!cleanCriteria.length) {
    return <div className="criteria-empty-state"><p className="empty-state-text">No individual criterion quotes were extracted for this trial.</p></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="criteria-section">
      <div className="criteria-header">
        <div className="criteria-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter criteria by assessment">
          {FILTERS.map((item) => (
            <button key={item.id} type="button" aria-pressed={filter === item.id}
              className={`filter-btn filter-${item.id.toLowerCase()} ${filter === item.id ? "filter-active" : ""}`}
              onClick={() => setFilter(item.id)}>
              {item.label} <span>{counts[item.id]}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {!displayed.length ? (
        <div className="criteria-no-matches"><p>No criteria match this filter.</p></div>
      ) : (
        <div className="criteria-table-wrap">
          <table className="criteria-table">
            <thead><tr><th scope="col">Trial requirement</th><th scope="col">Patient evidence</th><th scope="col">Assessment</th><th scope="col">Status</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{displayed.map((item, index) => {
              const requirement = item.criterion_quote || item.criterion || item.text || "Criterion text unavailable.";
              const evidence = item.patient_evidence || item.patient_evidence_quote || "";
              const source = item.source === "STRUCTURED" ? "Registry field" : "Trial text";
              return (
                <tr key={`${item.criterion_type || "criterion"}-${index}`} className={`criterion-row criterion-row-${item.impact || "UNKNOWN"}`}>
                  <td data-label="Trial requirement">
                    <div className="criterion-table-meta"><span className="criterion-type-pill">{item.criterion_type || "CRITERION"}</span><span className="criterion-source-tag">{source}</span></div>
                    <p className="criterion-table-quote">â€œ{requirement}â€</p>
                  </td>
                  <td data-label="Patient evidence">{evidence ? <blockquote className="criterion-patient-evidence">â€œ{evidence}â€</blockquote> : <span className="criterion-missing-evidence">Not provided in the case</span>}</td>
                  <td data-label="Assessment"><span className="criterion-assessment-text">{item.explanation || "No assessment explanation was returned."}</span></td>
                  <td data-label="Status"><Badge impact={item.impact} criterionType={item.criterion_type} size="sm" /></td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
