========== FILE: frontend\src\components\results\EvidenceDashboard.jsx ==========

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { downloadEvidenceReport } from "../../utils/evidenceReport";
import "./EvidenceDashboard.css";

const IMPACT_LABELS = {
  SUPPORTS: "Supported",
  BLOCKS: "Potential blockers",
  UNKNOWN: "Needs review",
};

function factList(profile = {}) {
  if (Array.isArray(profile.primary_conditions) && profile.primary_conditions.length) {
    return [...new Set(profile.primary_conditions.filter((fact) => typeof fact === "string" && fact.trim()))];
  }
  if (typeof profile.search_query === "string" && profile.search_query.trim()) {
    return [profile.search_query.trim()];
  }
  const facts = [
    ...(profile.key_findings || []),
    ...(profile.prior_treatments || []),
    ...(profile.current_medications || []),
  ];
  return [...new Set(facts.filter((fact) => typeof fact === "string" && fact.trim()))];
}

function countImpacts(matches) {
  return matches.reduce((counts, trial) => {
    (trial.criteria || []).forEach(({ impact }) => {
      if (impact in counts) counts[impact] += 1;
    });
    return counts;
  }, { SUPPORTS: 0, BLOCKS: 0, UNKNOWN: 0 });
}

/** Summarize search provenance and evidence completeness across the shortlist. */
export default function EvidenceDashboard({ data, sessionTitle }) {
  const matches = Array.isArray(data?.matches) ? data.matches : [];
  const ruledOut = Array.isArray(data?.ruled_out_trials) ? data.ruled_out_trials : [];
  const basis = useMemo(() => factList(data?.patient_profile), [data?.patient_profile]);
  const counts = useMemo(() => countImpacts(matches), [matches]);
  const assessed = counts.SUPPORTS + counts.BLOCKS + counts.UNKNOWN;
  const completeness = assessed ? Math.round(((assessed - counts.UNKNOWN) / assessed) * 100) : 0;
  const privacyTrimmed = !data?.patient_profile && matches.length > 0;

  const handleDownload = () => {
    downloadEvidenceReport({ data, sessionTitle });
  };

  return (
    <section className="evidence-dashboard" aria-labelledby="evidence-dashboard-title">
      <div className="evidence-dashboard-header">
        <div>
          <span className="section-eyebrow">REVIEW TRACE</span>
          <h2 id="evidence-dashboard-title">Evidence at a glance</h2>
          <p>See what informed the search, where the assessment has support, and what still needs human review.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" className="evidence-report-button" onClick={handleDownload}>
          <span aria-hidden="true">â†§</span> Download review report
        </button>
      </div>
      <p className="evidence-export-note">The report is generated on this device and may contain health-related evidence. Handle it according to your organizationâ€™s privacy practices.</p>

      <div className="evidence-dashboard-grid">
        <div className="evidence-basis-card">
          <div className="evidence-card-heading"><span className="evidence-step">01</span><h3>Why these trials surfaced</h3></div>
          <p className="evidence-card-caption">Primary conditions ground the initial search; a limited refinement may use other supported facts. Similarity ranks topic relevance only.</p>
          <div className="evidence-fact-chips">
            {basis.length ? basis.map((fact) => <span className="evidence-fact-chip" key={fact}>{fact}</span>) : <span className="evidence-muted">Search facts are unavailable in this saved result.</span>}
          </div>
          <div className="evidence-candidate-list">
            {matches.map((trial, index) => (
              <div className="evidence-candidate" key={trial.nct_id || index}>
                <span className="evidence-candidate-rank">{index + 1}</span>
                <div className="evidence-candidate-name"><strong>{trial.title}</strong><span>{trial.nct_id}</span></div>
                <span className="evidence-similarity" title="Retrieval similarity, not eligibility probability">{Math.round((trial.relevance_score || 0) * 100)}%<small>topic match</small></span>
              </div>
            ))}
            {!matches.length && <p className="evidence-muted">No candidate trials were returned for this search.</p>}
          </div>
          <p className="evidence-score-note">Topic similarity is not an eligibility score or probability.</p>
        </div>

        <div className="evidence-quality-card">
          <div className="evidence-card-heading"><span className="evidence-step">02</span><h3>Evidence coverage</h3></div>
          <p className="evidence-card-caption">Criterion checks across {matches.length} candidate{matches.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}. Open a trial below to inspect its source quotes.</p>
          <div className="evidence-coverage-meter" role="img" aria-label={`${completeness}% of criterion checks have supported or blocking evidence`}>
            <div className="evidence-coverage-fill" style={{ width: `${completeness}%` }} />
          </div>
          <div className="evidence-coverage-caption"><strong>{completeness}%</strong><span>{privacyTrimmed ? "checks assessed in saved summary" : "with evidence to review"}</span></div>
          <div className="evidence-impact-list">
            {Object.entries(IMPACT_LABELS).map(([impact, label]) => (
              <div className={`evidence-impact-row impact-${impact}`} key={impact}>
                <span className="evidence-impact-dot" /><span>{label}</span><strong>{counts[impact]}</strong>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="evidence-followup">
            <h4>Review before acting</h4>
            <p>{privacyTrimmed ? "This saved summary omits patient case excerpts. Rerun matching to inspect the verified patient evidence alongside each trial quote." : counts.UNKNOWN ? `${counts.UNKNOWN} criterion check${counts.UNKNOWN === 1 ? "" : "s"} lack enough evidence. Missing case facts and conflicts are listed below.` : "Compare every supported finding with the official study record and confirm the details with the clinical team."}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {ruledOut.length > 0 && (
        <div className="evidence-exclusions">
          <div><span className="section-eyebrow">SEPARATE REVIEW LIST</span><h3>Verified potential blockers</h3><p>These records had a blocking criterion in the assessed evidence. Confirm the quoted requirement against the official record.</p></div>
          <div className="evidence-exclusion-list">
            {ruledOut.map((trial) => (
              <article className="evidence-exclusion" key={trial.nct_id}>
                <div><strong>{trial.title}</strong><span>{trial.nct_id}</span><p>{trial.reason}</p></div>
                <a href={`https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/${encodeURIComponent(trial.nct_id)}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Source â†—</a>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {(data?.missing_key_facts?.length > 0 || data?.conflicting_facts?.length > 0) && (
        <div className="evidence-review-flags">
          {data?.missing_key_facts?.length > 0 && <div><h4>Information not provided</h4><ul>{data.missing_key_facts.map((item) => <li key={item}>{item}</li>)}</ul></div>}
          {data?.conflicting_facts?.length > 0 && <div><h4>Conflicts to resolve</h4><ul>{data.conflicting_facts.map((item) => <li key={item}>{item}</li>)}</ul></div>}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { deduplicatePassages } from "../../utils/deduplication";

/**
 * Retrieved Trial Passages & Citations view.
 */
export default function PassagesSection({
  passages = [],
  nctId = "",
  officialUrl = "",
}) {
  const cleanPassages = useMemo(() => {
    return deduplicatePassages(passages);
  }, [passages]);

  if (cleanPassages.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="passages-empty-state">
        <p>No raw text passages were returned for this trial.</p>
        {officialUrl && (
          <a
            href={officialUrl}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="external-study-link"
          >
            Open full study record on ClinicalTrials.gov â†—
          </a>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="passages-section">
      <div className="passages-header">
        <p className="passages-description">
          Retrieved evidence chunks from the official clinical trial study record in BigQuery.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="passages-grid">
        {cleanPassages.map((item, index) => {
          const type = (item.chunk_type || "Passage").toUpperCase();
          const text = item.text || "";

          return (
            <div key={index} className="passage-card">
              <div className="passage-card-header">
                <span className="passage-type-badge">{type}</span>
                {officialUrl && (
                  <a
                    href={officialUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="passage-study-link"
                    title="View on ClinicalTrials.gov"
                  >
                    {nctId} â†—
                  </a>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="passage-text">{text}</p>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import Badge from "../ui/Badge";
import Icon from "../ui/Icon";

/**
 * Extracted Patient Profile Component.
 * Displays structured facts with support for both schema standards and raw case viewing.
 */
export default function PatientProfileCard({
  profile = {},
  patientCase = "",
}) {
  const [showRawCase, setShowRawCase] = useState(false);

  if (!profile || typeof profile !== "object") return null;

  // Extract canonical or fallback fields
  const age =
    profile.age_years != null
      ? `${Math.round(profile.age_years)} years`
      : profile.age || null;

  const sex =
    profile.sex && profile.sex !== "UNKNOWN"
      ? profile.sex.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + profile.sex.slice(1).toLowerCase()
      : null;

  const conditions = Array.isArray(profile.primary_conditions)
    ? profile.primary_conditions
    : Array.isArray(profile.conditions)
    ? profile.conditions
    : profile.diagnosis
    ? [profile.diagnosis]
    : [];

  const findings = Array.isArray(profile.key_findings)
    ? profile.key_findings
    : Array.isArray(profile.biomarkers)
    ? profile.biomarkers
    : [];

  const priorTreatments = Array.isArray(profile.prior_treatments)
    ? profile.prior_treatments
    : [];

  const comorbidities = Array.isArray(profile.comorbidities)
    ? profile.comorbidities
    : [];

  const medications = Array.isArray(profile.current_medications)
    ? profile.current_medications
    : [];

  const searchQuery = profile.search_query || null;

  const hasAnyData =
    age ||
    sex ||
    conditions.length > 0 ||
    findings.length > 0 ||
    priorTreatments.length > 0 ||
    comorbidities.length > 0;

  if (!hasAnyData && !patientCase) return null;

  return (
    <div className="patient-profile-card">
      <div className="profile-header">
        <div className="profile-header-title">
          <span className="profile-header-icon"><Icon name="person" size={18} /></span>
          <div>
            <h3 className="profile-title">Extracted Clinical Profile</h3>
            <p className="profile-subtitle">
              Structured facts extracted by Gemini from the patient narrative
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {patientCase && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="toggle-raw-case-btn"
            onClick={() => setShowRawCase(!showRawCase)}
          >
            {showRawCase ? "Hide original case" : "View original case â†—"}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {hasAnyData && (
        <div className="profile-grid">
          {/* Patient Demographics */}
          {(age || sex) && (
            <div className="profile-field">
              <span className="field-label">Patient Demographics</span>
              <div className="field-tags">
                {age && <Badge variant="neutral">{age}</Badge>}
                {sex && <Badge variant="neutral">{sex}</Badge>}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Primary Condition(s) */}
          {conditions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="profile-field profile-field-wide">
              <span className="field-label">Primary Diagnosis</span>
              <div className="field-tags">
                {conditions.map((c, i) => (
                  <Badge key={i} variant="primary">
                    {c}
                  </Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Key Findings / Biomarkers / Staging */}
          {findings.length > 0 && (
            <div className="profile-field profile-field-wide">
              <span className="field-label">Key Findings & Biomarkers</span>
              <div className="field-tags">
                {findings.map((f, i) => (
                  <Badge key={i} variant="info">
                    {f}
                  </Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Prior Treatments */}
          {priorTreatments.length > 0 && (
            <div className="profile-field profile-field-wide">
              <span className="field-label">Prior Treatments</span>
              <div className="field-tags">
                {priorTreatments.map((t, i) => (
                  <Badge key={i} variant="neutral">
                    {t}
                  </Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Comorbidities */}
          {comorbidities.length > 0 && (
            <div className="profile-field profile-field-wide">
              <span className="field-label">Comorbidities</span>
              <div className="field-tags">
                {comorbidities.map((c, i) => (
                  <Badge key={i} variant="neutral">
                    {c}
                  </Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Current Medications */}
          {medications.length > 0 && (
            <div className="profile-field profile-field-wide">
              <span className="field-label">Current Medications</span>
              <div className="field-tags">
                {medications.map((m, i) => (
                  <Badge key={i} variant="neutral">
                    {m}
                  </Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* AI search query */}
      {searchQuery && (
        <div className="profile-search-query">
          <span className="query-label">Condition Query:</span>
          <code className="query-code">{searchQuery}</code>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Collapsible raw narrative case */}
      {showRawCase && patientCase && (
        <div className="raw-case-viewer">
          <div className="raw-case-header">
            <span>Original Clinical Narrative Case</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="raw-case-close"
              onClick={() => setShowRawCase(false)}
            >
              âœ•
            </button>
          </div>
          <p className="raw-case-text">{patientCase}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import Badge from "../ui/Badge";
import Button from "../ui/Button";

/**
 * Results Summary Bar with key counts, latency, and copy action.
 */
export default function ResultsOverview({
  data,
  onCopySummary,
  onOpenChat,
}) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.matches)) return null;

  const matches = data.matches;
  const total = matches.length;
  const reviewRequired = matches.filter(
    (m) => m.verdict === "ELIGIBLE" || m.verdict === "LIKELY ELIGIBLE"
  ).length;
  const possible = matches.filter(
    (m) =>
      m.verdict === "POSSIBLY_ELIGIBLE" ||
      m.verdict === "POSSIBLY ELIGIBLE"
  ).length;
  const couldNotAssess = matches.filter((m) => m.verdict === "COULD_NOT_ASSESS").length;

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (onCopySummary) {
      onCopySummary();
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="results-overview-bar">
      <div className="overview-stats">
        <div className="stat-item">
          <span className="stat-label">Candidate Trials</span>
          <span className="stat-value">{total}</span>
        </div>

        <div className="stat-divider" />

        <div className="stat-item">
          <span className="stat-label">Could Not Assess</span>
          <span className="stat-value">{couldNotAssess}</span>
        </div>

        <div className="stat-divider" />

        <div className="stat-item">
          <span className="stat-label">Requires Clinical Review</span>
          <span className="stat-value">{reviewRequired}</span>
        </div>

        <div className="stat-divider" />

        <div className="stat-item">
          <span className="stat-label">Possibly Eligible</span>
          <span className="stat-value text-warning">{possible}</span>
        </div>

        {data.latency_seconds > 0 && (
          <>
            <div className="stat-divider" />
            <div className="stat-item stat-latency">
              <span className="stat-label">Latency</span>
              <span className="stat-value-sm">{data.latency_seconds}s</span>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="overview-actions">
        {onOpenChat && (
          <Button
            variant="subtle"
            size="sm"
            onClick={onOpenChat}
            icon="ðŸ’¬"
            title="Ask questions about these trial candidates"
          >
            Ask AI Assistant
          </Button>
        )}

        {onCopySummary && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleCopy}
            icon={copied ? "âœ“" : "ðŸ“‹"}
            title="Copy match results summary to clipboard"
          >
            {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy Results"}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Deep-dive detail card for the currently selected clinical trial match.
 */
export default function TrialDetailView({
  match,
  onOpenChat,
  onCopyNotice,
}) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("criteria"); // 'criteria' | 'passages'
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState(false);

  if (!match) {
    return (
      <div className="trial-detail-empty">
        <p>Select a trial above to inspect detailed eligibility evidence.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const {
    nct_id,
    title,
    url,
    status = "RECRUITING",
    phases = [],
    conditions = [],
    sponsor,
    locations = [],
    relevance_score,
    verdict = "POSSIBLY_ELIGIBLE",
    summary = "",
    criteria = [],
    passages = [],
    dropped_unverified = 0,
  } = match;

  const officialUrl =
    url || (nct_id ? `https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/${nct_id}` : "");

  const handleCopyNctId = () => {
    if (nct_id) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(nct_id).catch(() => {});
      setCopiedId(true);
      if (onCopyNotice) onCopyNotice(`Copied ${nct_id} to clipboard`);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyTrialSummary = () => {
    const text = [
      `Trial: ${title} (${nct_id})`,
      `Verdict: ${verdict}`,
      `Relevance: ${formatScore(relevance_score)}`,
      `Status: ${status}`,
      summary ? `Summary: ${summary}` : "",
      officialUrl ? `URL: ${officialUrl}` : "",
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join("\n");

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).catch(() => {});
    if (onCopyNotice) onCopyNotice("Trial summary copied to clipboard");
  };

  // Metrics tallies
  const metCount = criteria.filter((c) => c.impact === "SUPPORTS").length;
  const blocksCount = criteria.filter((c) => c.impact === "BLOCKS").length;
  const unknownCount = criteria.filter(
    (c) => c.impact === "UNKNOWN" || !c.impact
  ).length;

  return (
    <article className="trial-detail-card" aria-labelledby="trial-detail-heading">
      {/* â”€â”€ Top Header â”€â”€ */}
      <div className="trial-detail-top">
        <div className="trial-header-main">
          <div className="trial-meta-pills">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="nct-id-button"
              onClick={handleCopyNctId}
              title="Click to copy NCT identifier"
            >
              <span>{nct_id}</span>
              <span className="copy-icon">{copiedId ? "âœ“" : "ðŸ“‹"}</span>
            </button>

            <span className="status-pill status-pill-active">{status}</span>

            {phases.length > 0 && (
              <span className="phase-pill">{phases.join(", ")}</span>
            )}

            {sponsor && <span className="sponsor-pill">{sponsor}</span>}
          </div>

          <h2 id="trial-detail-heading" className="trial-title">
            {title}
          </h2>

          {conditions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="conditions-row">
              {conditions.slice(0, 5).map((cond, i) => (
                <span key={i} className="condition-tag">
                  {cond}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* â”€â”€ Action bar â”€â”€ */}
        <div className="trial-header-actions">
          {officialUrl && (
            <a
              href={officialUrl}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="btn btn-outline btn-sm"
              title="View on ClinicalTrials.gov"
            >
              Study Record â†—
            </a>
          )}

          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleCopyTrialSummary}
            icon="ðŸ“‹"
            title="Copy trial details to clipboard"
          >
            Copy
          </Button>

          {onOpenChat && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onOpenChat}
              icon="ðŸ’¬"
              title="Ask AI follow-up questions about this trial"
            >
              Ask AI About Trial
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* â”€â”€ Evaluation Metrics Grid â”€â”€ */}
      <div className="trial-metrics-grid">
        {/* Verdict Box */}
        <div className={`verdict-summary-card verdict-${verdict}`}>
          <div className="verdict-card-top">
            <span className="verdict-card-label">ASSIGNED VERDICT</span>
            <Badge verdict={verdict} size="md" />
          </div>
          <p className="verdict-summary-text">
            {verdict === "ELIGIBLE"
              ? "No blockers were identified among the criteria assessed. A qualified clinical team must confirm eligibility."
              : verdict === "EXCLUDED"
              ? "At least one evaluated criterion blocks this patient based on documented evidence."
              : verdict === "COULD_NOT_ASSESS"
              ? "The available evidence was not sufficient to assess this trial's criteria."
              : "No definitive blockers identified, but certain required clinical criteria remain unknown."}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Semantic Topic Match */}
        <div className="metric-box">
          <div className="metric-box-header">

          </div>

                )}%`,
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <span className="metric-caption">
            Similarity of patient narrative to trial text. Not an eligibility score.
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Criteria Tallies */}
        <div className="metric-box tallies-box">
          <span className="metric-label">Criteria Evaluated</span>
          <div className="tallies-grid">
            <div className="tally-item tally-met">
              <span className="tally-count">{metCount}</span>
              <span className="tally-name">Met</span>
            </div>
            <div className="tally-item tally-blocks">
              <span className="tally-count">{blocksCount}</span>
              <span className="tally-name">Blocks</span>
            </div>
            <div className="tally-item tally-unknown">
              <span className="tally-count">{unknownCount}</span>
              <span className="tally-name">Could not assess</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* â”€â”€ AI Summary Box â”€â”€ */}
      {summary && (
        <div className="trial-ai-summary">
          <div className="summary-title-row">
            <span className="summary-icon">âœ¨</span>
            <span className="summary-heading">Clinical Assessment Summary</span>
          </div>

          >
            Eligibility Criteria ({criteria.length})
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={`detail-tab-btn ${
              activeTab === "passages" ? "detail-tab-active" : ""
            }`}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("passages")}
          >
            Retrieved Passages ({passages.length})
          </button>
        </div>

        {dropped_unverified > 0 && (
          <span className="unverified-badge" title="Statements dropped because verbatim quotes were not found in original source">
            âš  {dropped_unverified} unverified AI statement{dropped_unverified > 1 ? "s" : ""} discarded
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* â”€â”€ Content View â”€â”€ */}
      <div className="trial-detail-content">

          />
        )}
      </div>

      {locations.length > 0 && (

/** Three concise trial selectors with direct ClinicalTrials.gov citations. */
export default function TrialTabs({ matches = [], activeTab = 0, onSelectTab }) {
  if (!Array.isArray(matches) || matches.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="trial-tabs-container" role="group" aria-label="Candidate trials">
      {matches.slice(0, 3).map((trial, index) => {
        const isActive = index === activeTab;
        const rank = trial.rank ?? index + 1;
        const citationUrl = trial.url || `https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/${trial.nct_id}`;

            key={trial.nct_id || index}

              type="button"

                <Badge verdict={trial.verdict} size="sm" />
              </div>
              <span className="tab-title-text" title={trial.title}>
                {trial.title || "Untitled Trial"}
              </span>
              <div className="trial-card-facts">
                {trial.status && <span className="trial-card-status">{trial.status.replace(/_/g, " ")}</span>}
                {trial.phases?.length > 0 && <span>{trial.phases.join(", ")}</span>}

    </div>

========== FILE: frontend\src\components\session\RenameModal.jsx ==========

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import Modal from "../ui/Modal";
import Button from "../ui/Button";

/**
 * Modal to rename a session title.
 */
export default function RenameModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSave,
  currentTitle = "",
}) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(currentTitle);

  useEffect(() => {
    setTitle(currentTitle);
  }, [currentTitle, isOpen]);

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (title.trim()) {
      onSave(title.trim());
      onClose();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Rename Session"
      description="Enter a custom clinical or research title for this case."
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="rename-form">
        <input
          type="text"
          className="rename-input"
          value={title}
          onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="e.g. Stage IIIB NSCLC - 62yo Female"
          autoFocus
          maxLength={80}
        />
        <div className="rename-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onClose}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={!title.trim()}>
            Save Title
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}




========== FILE: frontend\src\components\session\SessionItem.jsx ==========

import React from "react";
import { formatRelativeTime, truncate } from "../../utils/formatters";
import Icon from "../ui/Icon";

/**
 * Individual session item in the sidebar.
 */
export default function SessionItem({
  session,
  isActive,
  onSelect,
  onRename,
  onDelete,
}) {
  const { id, title, patientCase, data, updatedAt, createdAt } = session;

  const matches = data?.matches || [];
  const matchCount = matches.length;
  const reviewRequiredCount = matches.filter(
    (m) => m.verdict === "ELIGIBLE" || m.verdict === "LIKELY ELIGIBLE"
  ).length;

  const snippet = patientCase ? truncate(patientCase, 85) : "Ready for a new clinical search";

  return (
    <div
      className={`session-item ${isActive ? "session-item-active" : ""}`}
      onClick={() => onSelect(id)}
      role="button"
      tabIndex={0}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
          e.preventDefault();
          onSelect(id);
        }
      }}
      aria-current={isActive ? "true" : undefined}
    >
      <div className="session-item-header">
        <div className="session-item-title-group">
          {isActive && <span className="active-dot" title="Active session" />}
          <span className="session-item-title" title={title}>
            {title || "Untitled Session"}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="session-item-actions" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="session-action-btn"
            title="Rename session"
            onClick={() => onRename(session)}
            aria-label={`Rename ${title}`}
          >
            <Icon name="edit" size={15} />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="session-action-btn session-action-danger"
            title="Delete session"
            onClick={() => onDelete(session)}
            aria-label={`Delete ${title}`}
          >
            <Icon name="trash" size={15} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <p className="session-item-snippet">{snippet}</p>

      <div className="session-item-meta">
        <span className="session-time">
          {formatRelativeTime(updatedAt || createdAt)}
        </span>

        {matchCount > 0 ? (
          <span className="session-badge session-badge-matched">
            {matchCount} {matchCount === 1 ? "trial" : "trials"}
            {reviewRequiredCount > 0 && ` â€¢ ${reviewRequiredCount} need review`}
          </span>
        ) : patientCase ? (
          <span className="session-badge session-badge-draft">Ready to match</span>
        ) : (
          <span className="session-badge session-badge-empty">Ready to search</span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}



========== FILE: frontend\src\components\session\SessionSidebar.jsx ==========

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import SessionItem from "./SessionItem";
import RenameModal from "./RenameModal";
import ConfirmDialog from "../ui/ConfirmDialog";
import Button from "../ui/Button";
import Icon from "../ui/Icon";

/**
 * Right-hand Session History & Management Sidebar.
 */
export default function SessionSidebar({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  sessions,
  activeSessionId,
  onSelectSession,
  onNewSession,
  onRenameSession,
  onDeleteSession,
  onClearAllSessions,
}) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [renamingSession, setRenamingSession] = useState(null);
  const [deletingSession, setDeletingSession] = useState(null);
  const [isClearAllOpen, setIsClearAllOpen] = useState(false);

  // Filtered session list based on search query
  const filteredSessions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return sessions;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return sessions.filter((s) => {
      const matchTitle = (s.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchCase = (s.patientCase || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchTrials = (s.data?.matches || []).some(
        (m) =>
          (m.nct_id || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (m.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
      return matchTitle || matchCase || matchTrials;
    });
  }, [sessions, searchQuery]);

  return (
    <>
      {/* Mobile Backdrop when sidebar is open as a drawer */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div
          className="sidebar-backdrop"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}

      <aside
        className={`session-sidebar ${isOpen ? "sidebar-open" : "sidebar-closed"}`}
        aria-label="Session history"
      >
        <div className="sidebar-header">
          <div className="sidebar-header-left">
            <span className="sidebar-title">My Sessions</span>
            <span className="sidebar-count">{sessions.length}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="sidebar-header-actions">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="xs"
              onClick={() => onNewSession()}
              title="Start a new patient match session"
              icon="+"
            >
              New
            </Button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="sidebar-close-btn"
              onClick={onClose}
              title="Close sidebar"
              aria-label="Close sidebar"
            >
              âœ•
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search input if multiple sessions exist */}
        {sessions.length > 1 && (
          <div className="sidebar-search">
            <span className="search-icon"><Icon name="search" size={15} /></span>
            <input
              type="text"
              className="sidebar-search-input"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Filter by diagnosis, case or NCT..."
              aria-label="Filter sessions"
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="search-clear-btn"
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                title="Clear filter"
              >
                âœ•
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Sessions scrollable list */}
        <div className="sidebar-list">
          {filteredSessions.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="sidebar-empty">
              {searchQuery ? (
                <>
                  <p className="sidebar-empty-title">No matching sessions</p>
                  <p className="sidebar-empty-text">
                    No session matches "{searchQuery}".
                  </p>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="xs"
                    onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                  >
                    Clear filter
                  </Button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="sidebar-empty-icon"><Icon name="folder" size={22} /></div>
                  <p className="sidebar-empty-title">No saved sessions</p>
                  <p className="sidebar-empty-text">
                    Your saved sessions and trial evaluations will appear here.
                  </p>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredSessions.map((session) => (
              <SessionItem
                key={session.id}
                session={session}
                isActive={session.id === activeSessionId}
                onSelect={(id) => {
                  onSelectSession(id);
                  if (window.innerWidth < 1024) {
                    onClose();
                  }
                }}
                onRename={(s) => setRenamingSession(s)}
                onDelete={(s) => setDeletingSession(s)}
              />
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer controls and account-scoped storage note */}
        <div className="sidebar-footer">
          <div className="sidebar-footer-info">
            <span className="info-icon"><Icon name="info" size={14} /></span>
            <span>Search queries, trial assessments, and chat are saved to your account. Delete a session to remove it.</span>
          </div>

          {sessions.length > 1 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="clear-all-btn"
              onClick={() => setIsClearAllOpen(true)}
            >
              Clear all sessions ({sessions.length})
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* Rename Modal */}
      {renamingSession && (
        <RenameModal
          isOpen={true}
          currentTitle={renamingSession.title}
          onClose={() => setRenamingSession(null)}
          onSave={(newTitle) => onRenameSession(renamingSession.id, newTitle)}
        />
      )}

      {/* Delete Single Session Dialog */}
      {deletingSession && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          isOpen={true}
          title="Delete Session"
          message={`Are you sure you want to delete "${deletingSession.title}"? Any matched trial data and Q&A in this session will be removed.`}
          confirmText="Delete Session"
          confirmVariant="danger"
          onClose={() => setDeletingSession(null)}
          onConfirm={() => {
            onDeleteSession(deletingSession.id);
            setDeletingSession(null);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Clear All Sessions Dialog */}
      {isClearAllOpen && (
        <ConfirmDialog
          isOpen={true}
          title="Clear All Sessions"
          message="Are you sure you want to remove all saved sessions from your account? This will delete their trial assessments and chat history."
          confirmText="Clear All"
          confirmVariant="danger"
          onClose={() => setIsClearAllOpen(false)}
          onConfirm={() => {
            onClearAllSessions();
            setIsClearAllOpen(false);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}




========== FILE: frontend\src\components\ui\Badge.jsx ==========

import React from "react";
import { criterionImpactLabel } from "../../utils/criterionImpact";

const VERDICTS = {
  ELIGIBLE: { label: "Requires clinical review", icon: "!", variant: "warning" },
  POSSIBLY_ELIGIBLE: { label: "Possibly eligible", icon: "!", variant: "warning" },
  COULD_NOT_ASSESS: { label: "Could not assess", icon: "?", variant: "neutral" },
  EXCLUDED: { label: "Excluded", icon: "Ã—", variant: "danger" },
};

const IMPACTS = {
  SUPPORTS: { label: "Supports trial", icon: "âœ“", variant: "success" },
  BLOCKS: { label: "Potential blocker", icon: "Ã—", variant: "danger" },
  UNKNOWN: { label: "Could not assess", icon: "?", variant: "neutral" },
};

/** Small accessible status label for trial verdicts and criterion outcomes. */
export default function Badge({
  children,
  verdict,
  impact,
  criterionType,
  variant = "default",
  size = "md",
  className = "",
  icon,
  title,
}) {
  const configuration = verdict
    ? VERDICTS[String(verdict).toUpperCase()] || { label: String(verdict), icon: "â€¢", variant: "neutral" }
    : impact ? {
      ...(IMPACTS[String(impact).toUpperCase()] || { label: String(impact), icon: "â€¢", variant: "neutral" }),
      label: criterionImpactLabel(impact, criterionType),
    } : null;

  if (!configuration) {
    return <span title={title} className={`badge badge-${variant} badge-${size} ${className}`}>
      {icon && <span className="badge-icon" aria-hidden="true">{icon}</span>}
      <span>{children}</span>
    </span>;
  }

  return (
    <span title={title || configuration.label} className={`badge badge-${configuration.variant} badge-${size} ${className}`}>
      <span className="badge-icon" aria-hidden="true">{icon || configuration.icon}</span>
      <span>{children || configuration.label}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

import React from "react";

/**
 * Reusable accessible Button component with multiple variants & sizes.
 */
export default function Button({
  children,
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  loading = false,
  disabled = false,
  icon = null,
  iconRight = null,
  className = "",
  type = "button",
  onClick,
  title,
  ...props
}) {
  const isDisabled = disabled || loading;

  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      disabled={isDisabled}
      onClick={onClick}
      title={title}
      className={`btn btn-${variant} btn-${size} ${className}`}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <span className="btn-spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
      ) : icon ? (
        <span className="btn-icon-left">{icon}</span>
      ) : null}

      <span className="btn-label">{children}</span>

      {!loading && iconRight && (
        <span className="btn-icon-right">{iconRight}</span>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

========== FILE: frontend\src\components\ui\Modal.jsx ==========

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

/**
 * Accessible Modal dialog component with focus lock, Escape key handler, and backdrop blur.
 */
export default function Modal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  maxWidth = "max-w-md",
  className = "",
}) {
  const modalRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return undefined;

    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        onClose();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    // Prevent background scrolling while modal is open
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="modal-overlay"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="modal-title"
      onMouseDown={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
          onClose();
        }
      }}
    >
      <div
        ref={modalRef}
        className={`modal-container ${maxWidth} ${className}`}
        tabIndex={-1}
      >
        <div className="modal-header">
          <div>
            <h3 id="modal-title" className="modal-title">
              {title}
            </h3>
            {description && (
              <p className="modal-description">{description}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="modal-close-btn"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close dialog"
          >
            âœ•
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="modal-body">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

========== FILE: frontend\src\hooks\useSessionManager.js ==========

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import {
  clearRemoteSessions,
  createSession as createRemoteSession,
  deleteRemoteSession,
  getSession,
  listSessions,
  renameRemoteSession,
} from "../api";
import { clearAllStorage } from "../utils/storage";

function normalizeSession(session) {
  return {
    id: session.id,
    title: session.title || "New Patient Session",
    patientCase: session.searchQuery || "",
    data: session.data || null,
    activeTab: 0,
    chatHistory: session.chatHistory || [],
    createdAt: session.createdAt || Date.now(),
    updatedAt: session.updatedAt || Date.now(),
  };
}

export function useSessionManager(user) {
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState([]);
  const [activeSessionId, setActiveSessionId] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loadingSessionId, setLoadingSessionId] = useState(null);
  const switchRequest = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    clearAllStorage(); // remove legacy per-tab cases/chat before loading user data
    setSessions([]);
    setActiveSessionId(null);
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    (async () => {
      try {
        let loaded = await listSessions();
        if (!Array.isArray(loaded)) loaded = [];
        if (loaded.length === 0) {
          loaded = [await createRemoteSession()];
        }
        if (!mounted) return;
        const normalized = loaded.map(normalizeSession);
        setSessions(normalized);
        const first = normalized[0];
        setActiveSessionId(first.id);
        const details = await getSession(first.id);
        if (mounted) {
          setSessions((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === first.id
            ? { ...item, ...normalizeSession(details) }
            : item));
        }
      } catch (loadError) {
        if (mounted) setError(loadError.message || "Could not load saved sessions.");
      } finally {
        if (mounted) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, [user?.firebaseUser?.uid]);

  const activeSession = useMemo(
    () => sessions.find((session) => session.id === activeSessionId) || null,
    [sessions, activeSessionId],
  );

  const switchSession = useCallback(async (id) => {
    const requestId = ++switchRequest.current;
    setLoadingSessionId(id);
    setError("");
    try {
      const detail = await getSession(id);
      if (requestId !== switchRequest.current) return;
      setSessions((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === id
        ? { ...item, ...normalizeSession(detail) }
        : item));
      setActiveSessionId(id);
      return true;
    } catch (loadError) {
      if (requestId === switchRequest.current) setError(loadError.message || "Could not open this session.");
      return false;
    } finally {
      if (requestId === switchRequest.current) setLoadingSessionId(null);
    }
  }, []);

  const createNewSession = useCallback(async (title) => {
    switchRequest.current += 1;
    setLoadingSessionId(null);
    setError("");
    try {
      const created = normalizeSession(await createRemoteSession(title));
      setSessions((current) => [created, ...current]);
      setActiveSessionId(created.id);
      setError("");
      return created;
    } catch (createError) {
      setError(createError.message || "Could not create a session.");
      throw createError;
    }
  }, []);

  const updateSession = useCallback((id, patch) => {
    if (!id) return;
    const { touch = false, ...sessionPatch } = patch;
    setSessions((current) => {
      const next = current.map((session) => {
        if (session.id !== id) return session;
        const updated = { ...session, ...sessionPatch, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        if (sessionPatch.title && sessionPatch.title !== session.title) {
          renameRemoteSession(id, sessionPatch.title).catch((renameError) => {
            setError(renameError.message || "Could not save the session name.");
          });
        }
        return updated;
      });
      if (touch || sessionPatch.data || sessionPatch.chatHistory || sessionPatch.title) {
        next.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime());
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const updateActiveSession = useCallback((patch) => {
    updateSession(activeSessionId, patch);
  }, [activeSessionId, updateSession]);

  const renameSession = useCallback(async (id, title) => {
    const cleanTitle = title?.trim().slice(0, 100);
    if (!cleanTitle) return;
    try {
      await renameRemoteSession(id, cleanTitle);
      setSessions((current) => {
        const renamed = current.map((item) => item.id === id
          ? { ...item, title: cleanTitle, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
          : item);
        return renamed.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime());
      });
    } catch (renameError) {
      setError(renameError.message || "Could not rename this session.");
    }
  }, []);

  const deleteSession = useCallback(async (id) => {
    try {
      await deleteRemoteSession(id);
      let remaining = sessions.filter((item) => item.id !== id);
      if (remaining.length === 0) remaining = [normalizeSession(await createRemoteSession())];
      setSessions(remaining);
      if (activeSessionId === id) setActiveSessionId(remaining[0].id);
    } catch (deleteError) {
      setError(deleteError.message || "Could not delete this session.");
    }
  }, [sessions, activeSessionId]);

  const clearAllSessions = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await clearRemoteSessions();
      const fresh = normalizeSession(await createRemoteSession());
      setSessions([fresh]);
      setActiveSessionId(fresh.id);
    } catch (clearError) {
      setError(clearError.message || "Could not clear saved sessions.");
    }
  }, []);

  return {
    sessions,
    activeSessionId,
    activeSession,
    loading,
    loadingSessionId,
    error,
    switchSession,
    createNewSession,
    updateActiveSession,
    updateSession,
    renameSession,
    deleteSession,
    clearAllSessions,
  };
}



========== FILE: frontend\src\hooks\useToast.js ==========

import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from "react";

/**
 * Hook for lightweight toast notifications.
 */
export function useToast() {
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const timeoutRef = useRef(null);

  const showToast = useCallback((message, type = "info", duration = 3500) => {
    if (timeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    }
    setToast({ message, type, id: Date.now() });
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setToast(null);
    }, duration);
  }, []);

  const hideToast = useCallback(() => {
    if (timeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    }
    setToast(null);
  }, []);

  return { toast, showToast, hideToast };
}

========== FILE: frontend\src\utils\assessment.js ==========

/** Count criterion outcomes for one trial assessment. */
export function countCriteria(criteria = []) {
  return criteria.reduce((counts, item) => {
    if (item.impact === "SUPPORTS") counts.met += 1;
    else if (item.impact === "BLOCKS") counts.blocking += 1;
    else counts.unknown += 1;
    return counts;
  }, { met: 0, blocking: 0, unknown: 0 });
}

/** Use the saved assessment first, with a cautious fallback when it is absent. */
export function getAssessmentSummary(match, counts) {
  if (match?.summary) return match.summary;
  if (counts.blocking) {
    return "One or more assessed criteria may conflict with this patient case. Review the evidence and confirm against the official trial record.";
  }
  return "The available criteria do not establish eligibility. Some information may be missing or unassessed; a qualified clinical team must review the official criteria.";
}



========== FILE: frontend\src\utils\criterionImpact.js ==========

export function criterionImpactLabel(impact, criterionType) {
  const normalizedImpact = String(impact || "UNKNOWN").toUpperCase();
  const normalizedType = String(criterionType || "").toUpperCase();

  if (normalizedImpact === "UNKNOWN") return "Could not assess";
  if (!["SUPPORTS", "BLOCKS"].includes(normalizedImpact)) return "Could not assess";
  if (normalizedType === "INCLUSION") {
    return normalizedImpact === "SUPPORTS" ? "Met" : "Not met";
  }
  if (normalizedType === "EXCLUSION") {
    return normalizedImpact === "BLOCKS" ? "Met" : "Not met";
  }
  return normalizedImpact === "SUPPORTS" ? "Supports trial" : "Potential blocker";
}



========== FILE: frontend\src\utils\deduplication.js ==========

/**
 * Deduplication utilities to prevent repetitive or duplicated content in outputs.
 */

/**
 * Deduplicate a list of criteria results.
 * Compares normalized criterion_quote + impact + patient_evidence.
 * @param {Array<Object>} criteria
 * @returns {Array<Object>}
 */
export function deduplicateCriteria(criteria) {
  if (!Array.isArray(criteria)) return [];

  const seen = new Set();
  const result = [];

  for (const item of criteria) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object") continue;

    const quote = (item.criterion_quote || item.criterion || item.text || "")
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
    const impact = (item.impact || "").trim().toUpperCase();
    const evidence = (item.patient_evidence || item.patient_evidence_quote || "")
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

    // Unique fingerprint for this criterion
    const key = `${impact}:::${quote}:::${evidence}`;

    if (!quote && !evidence) continue;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;

    seen.add(key);
    result.push(item);
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Deduplicate a list of retrieved passages.
 * Compares chunk_type + normalized text.
 * @param {Array<Object>} passages
 * @returns {Array<Object>}
 */
export function deduplicatePassages(passages) {
  if (!Array.isArray(passages)) return [];

  const seen = new Set();
  const result = [];

  for (const p of passages) {
    if (!p || typeof p !== "object") continue;

    const type = (p.chunk_type || "passage").trim().toLowerCase();
    const text = (p.text || "").trim();

    if (!text) continue;

    // Normalize whitespace for comparison
    const normText = text.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 200);
    const key = `${type}:::${normText}`;

    if (seen.has(key)) continue;

    seen.add(key);
    result.push(p);
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Deduplicate chat citations by NCT ID and section.
 * @param {Array<Object>} citations
 * @returns {Array<Object>}
 */
export function deduplicateCitations(citations) {
  if (!Array.isArray(citations)) return [];

  const seen = new Set();
  const result = [];

  for (const c of citations) {
    if (!c || typeof c !== "object") continue;
    const nctId = (c.nct_id || "").trim().toUpperCase();
    const section = (c.section || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const key = `${nctId}:::${section}`;

    if (!nctId) continue;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;

    seen.add(key);
    result.push(c);
  }

  return result;
}




========== FILE: frontend\src\utils\evidenceReport.js ==========

/** Build and download a self-contained, print-ready evidence review report. */
import { criterionImpactLabel } from "./criterionImpact.js";

const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? "")
  .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
  .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
  .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
  .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
  .replaceAll("'", "&#39;");

const list = (items) => (Array.isArray(items) ? items : []);

function renderList(items, emptyText) {
  const values = list(items).filter(Boolean);
  return values.length
    ? `<ul>${values.map((item) => `<li>${escapeHtml(item)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>`
    : `<p class="muted">${escapeHtml(emptyText)}</p>`;
}

function renderTrial(trial, index) {
  const criteria = list(trial.criteria);
  const criterionRows = criteria.length
    ? criteria.map((criterion) => `
      <article class="criterion">
        <div class="criterion-heading"><strong>${escapeHtml(criterion.criterion_type || "Criterion")}</strong><span class="impact impact-${escapeHtml(criterion.impact || "UNKNOWN")}">${escapeHtml(criterionImpactLabel(criterion.impact, criterion.criterion_type))}</span></div>
        <p class="label">Trial source text</p><blockquote>${escapeHtml(criterion.criterion_quote || "No verified trial quote available.")}</blockquote>
        <p class="label">Patient evidence</p><blockquote>${escapeHtml(criterion.patient_evidence || "No verified patient evidence was returned. Review the original case and trial criterion.")}</blockquote>
        ${criterion.explanation ? `<p class="explanation">${escapeHtml(criterion.explanation)}</p>` : ""}
      </article>`).join("")
    : '<p class="muted">No criterion-level evidence was retained in this result.</p>';
  const url = /^https:\/\/clinicaltrials\.gov\/study\/NCT\d{8}$/i.test(trial.url || "")
    ? trial.url
    : `https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/${encodeURIComponent(trial.nct_id || "")}`;
  const score = Number.isFinite(Number(trial.relevance_score))
    ? `${Math.round(Number(trial.relevance_score) * 100)}%`
    : "Unavailable";

  return `
    <section class="trial">
      <div class="trial-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">CANDIDATE ${index + 1} Â· ${escapeHtml(trial.nct_id)}</p><h2>${escapeHtml(trial.title || "Untitled trial")}</h2></div><span class="verdict">${escapeHtml(trial.verdict || "Not assessed")}</span></div>
      <p class="muted">Topic similarity: ${escapeHtml(score)}. This is a retrieval relevance score, not an eligibility probability.</p>
      <p><a href="${escapeHtml(url)}">Open official ClinicalTrials.gov record â†—</a></p>
      <p>${escapeHtml(trial.status || "Status unavailable")}${list(trial.phases).length ? ` Â· ${escapeHtml(list(trial.phases).join(", "))}` : ""}</p>
      <h3>Criterion evidence</h3>${criterionRows}
    </section>`;
}

function renderRuledOut(trial) {
  const id = String(trial.nct_id || "");
  const sourceUrl = `https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
  return `<article class="criterion"><div class="criterion-heading"><strong>${escapeHtml(trial.title || "Trial")}</strong><span class="impact impact-BLOCKS">Potential blocker</span></div><p><a href="${escapeHtml(sourceUrl)}">${escapeHtml(id)} Â· Official study record â†—</a></p><blockquote>${escapeHtml(trial.reason || "A verified blocking criterion was recorded.")}</blockquote><p class="muted">Confirm this criterion with the clinical team and official record.</p></article>`;
}

export function downloadEvidenceReport(options) {
  const html = buildEvidenceReportHtml(options);
  const blob = new Blob([html], { type: "text/html;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const anchor = document.createElement("a");
  anchor.href = url;
  anchor.download = `clinical-trial-review-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.html`;
  document.body.appendChild(anchor);
  anchor.click();
  anchor.remove();
  window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}



========== FILE: frontend\src\utils\formatters.js ==========

/**
 * Formatters for clinical data, dates, scores, and text truncation.
 */

/**
 * Format a timestamp into a human-friendly relative or calendar string.
 * @param {number|string|Date} timestamp
 * @returns {string} e.g. "Just now", "5m ago", "Today at 2:30 PM", or "Oct 21, 2026"
 */
export function formatRelativeTime(timestamp) {
  if (!timestamp) return "Recently";
  const date = new Date(timestamp);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return "Recently";

  const now = Date.now();
  const diffMs = now - date.getTime();
  const diffSec = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffSec / 60);
  const diffHour = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
  const diffDay = Math.floor(diffHour / 24);

  if (diffSec < 30) return "Just now";
  if (diffMin < 60) return `${diffMin}m ago`;
  if (diffHour < 24) return `${diffHour}h ago`;
  if (diffDay === 1) return "Yesterday";
  if (diffDay < 7) return `${diffDay}d ago`;

  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: date.getFullYear() !== new Date().getFullYear() ? "numeric" : undefined,
  });
}

/**
 * Format exact date and time.
 * @param {number|string|Date} timestamp
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatFullDateTime(timestamp) {
  if (!timestamp) return "";
  const date = new Date(timestamp);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  return date.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

/**
 * Format relevance similarity score to percentage.
 * @param {number|string} score
 * @returns {string} e.g. "92%"
 */
export function formatScore(score) {
  if (score === undefined || score === null || score === "") return "0%";
  const num = Number(score);
  if (isNaN(num)) return "0%";
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, num <= 1 ? num : num / 100));
  return `${Math.round(clamped * 100)}%`;
}

/**
 * Safely truncate a string with ellipsis.
 * @param {string} text
 * @param {number} maxLen
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function truncate(text, maxLen = 80) {
  if (!text || typeof text !== "string") return "";
  const clean = text.trim();
  if (clean.length <= maxLen) return clean;
  return clean.slice(0, maxLen).trim() + "â€¦";
}

/**
 * Generate a smart session title based on the patient case text.
 * E.g. extracts age, diagnosis, or disease stage, or falls back to short summary.
 * @param {string} patientCase
 * @param {Object} [profile]
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function generateSessionTitle(patientCase, profile) {
  if (!patientCase || !patientCase.trim()) return "New Patient Session";

  const explicitAges = [...patientCase.matchAll(/\b(\d{1,3})(?:\s*years?\s*old|-year-old|\s*yo)\b/gi)];
  const caseAge = explicitAges.length === 1 ? Number(explicitAges[0][1]) : null;

  // If we have an extracted profile, build an informative clinical title
  if (profile) {
    const parts = [];
    if (caseAge != null) parts.push(`${caseAge}yo`);
    else if (profile.age_years != null && explicitAges.length === 0) {
      parts.push(`${Math.round(profile.age_years)}yo`);
    }
    if (profile.sex && profile.sex !== "UNKNOWN") {
      parts.push(profile.sex === "FEMALE" ? "Female" : "Male");
    }
    if (profile.primary_conditions && profile.primary_conditions.length > 0) {
      parts.push(profile.primary_conditions[0]);
    }
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      return parts.join(" â€¢ ");
    }
  }

  // Fallback heuristic extraction from text
  const clean = patientCase.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");

  // Check for common age/gender patterns, e.g. "62-year-old woman with newly diagnosed stage IIIB..."
  const match = clean.match(
    /^(\d{1,3}[-\s]?year[-\s]?old\s+(?:woman|man|female|male|patient))/i
  );
  if (match) {
    const remainder = clean.slice(match[0].length).replace(/^[,.\s]+(?:with|diagnosed with|having)?\s*/i, "");
    const condition = remainder.split(/[,.]/)[0].trim();
    if (condition && condition.length < 40) {
      return `${match[1]} â€¢ ${condition}`;
    }
    return match[1];
  }

  // Otherwise, take first sentence or 45 chars
  const firstSentence = clean.split(/[.?!]/)[0].trim();
  if (firstSentence.length > 0 && firstSentence.length <= 50) {
    return firstSentence;
  }
  return truncate(clean, 42);
}

/**

 * Patient cases and matching sessions now come from the authenticated API.

    window.sessionStorage.removeItem("clinical_trial_rag_sessions_v2");
    window.sessionStorage.removeItem("clinical_trial_rag_active_id_v2");
  } catch (error) {

    console.warn("Failed to clear legacy session storage:", error);
  }
}

========== FILE: ARCHITECTURE.md ==========

# Clinical Trial RAG Architecture

## Table of Contents

- [Overview](#overview)
- [High-Level Architecture](#high-level-architecture)
- [Production File-Level Flow](#production-file-level-flow)
- [Components](#components)
- [Main User Flow](#main-user-flow)
- [Business Logic](#business-logic)
- [Data Model](#data-model)
- [Deployment](#deployment)
- [Security](#security)
- [Scalability](#scalability)

## Overview

The system has a React/Vite client, Firebase Authentication, a Python/FastAPI service, and Google Cloud data/model services. FastAPI verifies Firebase ID tokens before profile, session, matching, or chat operations. The matching workflow retrieves indexed trial chunks from BigQuery, uses Google ADK and Gemini for structured extraction and assessment, verifies evidence in application code, and saves the validated query and full structured result to the owning user's Firestore session.

## High-Level Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    User[Clinical technician] --> Web[React and Vite]
    Web -->|Sign in| Auth[Firebase Authentication]
    Web -->|Bearer token| API[FastAPI]
    API -->|Verify token| Auth
    API -->|Profile session and chat| DB[(Cloud Firestore)]
    API --> Workflow[Validation and matching workflow]
    Workflow -->|Vector search| BQ[(BigQuery trial chunks)]
    Workflow -->|Structured model tasks| Model[Google ADK and Gemini]
    Ingest[ClinicalTrials.gov ingestion] -->|Chunk and embed| BQ
```

The browser obtains an ID token from Firebase and sends it to FastAPI. The API verifies the token, enforces UID/session ownership, calls the matching or chat workflow, and persists user data through Firebase Admin. Trial ingestion is an offline path independent of user requests.

The evidence dashboard summarizes validated search facts and criterion coverage across the returned shortlist. Criterion detail remains tied to verified trial quotes and supported patient evidence. Its print-ready HTML report is assembled in the browser on demand, includes official ClinicalTrials.gov links, and is not sent back to the API.

## Components

| Component | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| React/Vite workspace | Sign-in, case intake, trial shortlist, evidence traceability dashboard, trial detail, and follow-up chat UI. |
| Firebase Authentication | Email/password accounts and signed ID tokens. |
| FastAPI `main.py` | HTTP routes, CORS, request IDs, authentication dependencies, and error mapping. |
| `auth_dependency.py` / `firebase_auth.py` | Verify ID tokens and initialize Firebase Admin/Firestore access. |
| `user_data.py` | Store profiles, queries, full match results, and chat turns under a user's UID. |
| `pipeline.py` / `workflow.py` | Validate cases, apply urgent screening, retrieve candidates, assess criteria, and rank results. |
| `adk_runtime.py` / `tasks.py` / `tools.py` | Run constrained extraction, assessment, and chat model tasks with bounded retrieval. |
| `eligibility_judge.py` | Verify criterion quotes and calculate conservative verdicts in ordinary application code. |
| `chat.py` / `retriever.py` / `trial_store.py` | Retrieve evidence for allowed trial IDs and create cited responses. |
| Ingestion scripts | Fetch, normalize, chunk, embed, and load trial data. |
| BigQuery and Vertex AI | Store/search trial vectors and create embeddings. |

## Main User Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant UI as React client
    participant Firebase as Firebase Auth
    participant API as FastAPI
    participant DB as Firestore
    participant WF as Matching and chat workflow
    participant Cloud as BigQuery and Gemini
    User->>UI: Sign in or create account
    UI->>Firebase: Authenticate with email and password
    Firebase-->>UI: Return ID token
    UI->>API: Request profile with bearer token
    API->>Firebase: Verify ID token
    API->>DB: Read or initialize users/{uid}
    DB-->>API: Return profile
    API->>DB: List user sessions
    DB-->>API: Return session list
    API-->>UI: Return profile and session list
    User->>UI: Submit anonymized case
    UI->>API: POST /api/match with token and session ID
    API->>DB: Confirm session belongs to token UID
    API->>WF: Validate, screen, retrieve, and assess
    WF->>Cloud: Search BigQuery and call Gemini tasks
    Cloud-->>WF: Trial evidence and structured proposals
    WF-->>API: Quote-verified shortlist
    API->>DB: Save query, timestamps, matched IDs, and full result
    API-->>UI: Return up to three candidates
    User->>UI: Ask a question about selected trials
    UI->>API: POST /api/trials/chat with token, session, and trial IDs
    API->>DB: Verify ownership and session trial membership
    API->>WF: Retrieve selected-trial evidence and answer
    WF->>Cloud: Fetch evidence and call Gemini
    WF-->>API: Cited answer
    API->>DB: Save chat turn
    API-->>UI: Return answer and citations
```

The API checks token identity and session ownership before processing case matching or chat. Chat trial IDs must be part of that session's saved result. Model proposals are validated before they are returned or persisted.

## Business Logic

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Case[Anonymized case] --> Validate{Input checks pass?}
    Validate -->|No| Reject[Return validation error]
    Validate -->|Yes| Urgent{Urgent warning phrase found?}
    Urgent -->|Yes| Notice[Return notice without model or retrieval]
    Urgent -->|No| Extract[Extract structured facts]
    Extract --> VerifyFacts[Verify facts against case]
    VerifyFacts --> Retrieve[Retrieve candidate trial chunks]
    Retrieve --> Refine{No candidates or weak best score?}
    Refine -->|Yes| Optional[Allow one supported refinement]
    Refine -->|No| Cap[Deduplicate and cap candidates]
    Optional --> Cap
    Cap --> Assess[Assess candidates concurrently]
    Assess --> VerifyQuotes[Verify source quotations]
    VerifyQuotes --> Blocker{Verified blocking criterion?}
    Blocker -->|Yes| Excluded[Record verified exclusion]
    Blocker -->|No| Candidate[Rank non-excluded candidates]
    Excluded --> Result[Return evidence and uncertainty]
    Candidate --> Result
```

A request makes one initial retrieval and at most one validated refinement retrieval. Candidate count and assessment concurrency are capped. A verified blocking criterion excludes a trial; otherwise, supported evidence can yield `POSSIBLY_ELIGIBLE`, while no supported criterion evidence yields `COULD_NOT_ASSESS`. The application never treats retrieval similarity as eligibility probability.

## Data Model

```mermaid
erDiagram
    USER ||--o{ SESSION : owns
    SESSION ||--o{ MESSAGE : contains
    SESSION ||--o{ MATCHED_TRIAL : summarizes
    TRIAL ||--o{ TRIAL_CHUNK : indexed_as
    USER {
        string uid
        string email
        string display_name
        string role
    }
    SESSION {
        string session_id
        string title
        string status
        timestamp created_at
        timestamp updated_at
    }
    MESSAGE {
        string message_id
        string turn_id
        string role
        string content
        timestamp created_at
    }
    MATCHED_TRIAL {
        string nct_id
        string title
        string verdict
        string criterion_quotes
        float relevance_score
    }
    TRIAL {
        string nct_id
        string title
        string status
    }
    TRIAL_CHUNK {
        string chunk_id
        string nct_id
        string chunk_type
        string text
        vector embedding
    }
```

Firestore paths are `users/{uid}`, `users/{uid}/sessions/{sessionId}`, and `users/{uid}/sessions/{sessionId}/messages/{messageId}`. Each session stores its title, validated search query, `createdAt`, `searchedAt`, `updatedAt`, matched-trial IDs, complete structured matching result, and status. The result retains criteria assessments and evidence so a reopened session can be restored. Chat turns use deterministic message document IDs, so a retried chat request updates the same records instead of duplicating them. Sidebar listing returns a lightweight result preview; opening a session returns the full result and chat history. BigQuery stores trial chunks and embeddings. The diagram shows conceptual relationships, not a claim that each entity is a separate collection/table.

## Deployment

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Browser[Browser] -->|HTTPS| Frontend[Static frontend host]
    Frontend -->|Firebase web SDK| Auth[Firebase Authentication]
    Frontend -->|Bearer ID token| API[FastAPI service]
    API -->|Verify token| Auth
    API -->|Admin SDK and ADC| Firestore[(Cloud Firestore)]
    API -->|Vector search| BQ[(BigQuery)]
    API -->|Model calls| Vertex[Vertex AI and Gemini]
    Job[Trial ingestion job] -->|Write trial chunks| BQ
    Job -. Optional processed files .-> GCS[(Cloud Storage)]
```

This is the deployment shape supported by the code; no production hosting manifests are included. Use HTTPS, configure the production frontend origin in CORS, and grant the API service identity only the necessary Firebase/Firestore, BigQuery, and Vertex AI permissions. Deploy `firestore.rules`, which denies direct browser database reads and writes.

## Security

- Firebase ID tokens are required for profile, session, matching, and chat routes. Health and readiness routes remain public.
- The backend derives the UID from a verified token, scopes Firestore paths to that UID, and checks session ownership.
- Chat requests can use only trial IDs in the owned session's saved match result.
- The application role is fixed to `clinical_technician` by the backend.
- Firestore client rules deny direct browser access. Admin SDK writes rely on server credentials and API ownership checks.
- Token verification skips a per-request revocation lookup to reduce latency; a revoked token may remain accepted until normal expiration.
- Submitted, identifier-screened patient case narratives, match assessments, and chat turns are persisted under the owning user's session. Delete a session to remove its saved data. The identifier check is limited and does not provide comprehensive de-identification.
- Retrieved trial text and patient input are treated as untrusted. Retrieval is bounded; structured outputs and quotations are validated before final verdicts.
- Identifier screening and urgent phrase checks are limited safeguards, not comprehensive de-identification or emergency triage.
- No regulatory compliance certification is claimed. Results require qualified clinical review.

## Scalability

- Candidate assessment and final-result caps come from configuration; concurrent assessment is bounded by `ADK_CONCURRENCY`.
- Each model call and retrieval call has a timeout. The matching and chat workflows also have derived overall timeouts capped in code.
- BigQuery provides managed vector storage and search. Monitor query cost and latency when tuning `CANDIDATES_TO_RETRIEVE`.
- Ingestion is independent of request handling and can be scheduled externally; the repository does not include a scheduler or autoscaling configuration.
- User data is partitioned by Firebase UID. Session and message retrieval limits bound data returned to the client.
- Production still needs platform-specific autoscaling, rate limits, monitoring, deployment automation, and data-retention policies.

The mocked workflow latency regression test compares the same six delayed assessment calls at concurrency 1 and 6. A local run measured medians of 226.3 ms and 39.9 ms respectively. These values validate the concurrency change in a simulated workflow; they do not predict live model or BigQuery latency.

```mermaid
        Vertex[Vertex AI embeddings]
        GCS[(Cloud Storage<br/>optional processed JSON)]
    end

    AuthUI --> AuthState
    AuthState --> FirebaseClient
    FirebaseClient <--> Firebase
    AuthState -->|profile request with ID token| API
    App --> SessionHook
    App --> API
    SessionHook --> API
    API -->|Bearer ID token| Main
    Main --> Schemas
    Main --> AuthDep --> AuthSvc --> Firebase
    Main -->|profile, session, query, result, chat| UserData --> Firestore
    Main --> Pipeline --> Workflow
    Workflow --> Tasks --> Runtime --> Gemini
    Workflow --> Tools --> Retriever
    Retriever --> Embed --> Vertex
    Retriever --> BigQuery
    Workflow --> Judge
    Workflow --> TrialStore --> GCS
    TrialStore -->|local fallback| Local[(backend/data/processed JSON)]
    Main --> Chat
    Chat --> BigQuery
    Chat --> Embed
    Chat --> Tasks
    Main -->|validated JSON response| API
    API --> ResultUI
    API --> ChatUI
```

### Search request, in execution order

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor Technician
    participant UI as App.jsx
    participant Client as api.js
    participant Route as main.py /api/match
    participant Auth as auth_dependency.py + firebase_auth.py
    participant Store as user_data.py / Firestore
    participant Pipe as pipeline.py
    participant Flow as agents/workflow.py
    participant Search as retriever.py + embeddings.py
    participant Model as tasks.py + adk_runtime.py / Gemini
    participant Judge as eligibility_judge.py

    Technician->>UI: Enter anonymized patient case
    UI->>Client: matchPatient(case, sessionId)
    Client->>Client: Get Firebase ID token
    Client->>Route: POST /api/match + bearer token + request body
    Route->>Auth: Resolve authenticated Firebase UID
    Auth-->>Route: Verified user claims
    Route->>Store: Confirm session ownership or create session
    Route->>Pipe: Validate case and screen urgent warning signs
    Pipe->>Flow: run_workflow_async(case)
    Flow->>Model: Extract patient facts
    Model-->>Flow: Structured patient profile
    Flow->>Search: Search trial candidates
    Search-->>Flow: Ranked candidates and source chunk IDs
    Flow->>Model: Assess shortlisted trial criteria
    Model-->>Flow: Proposed criteria with quotes and explanations
    Flow->>Judge: Verify quotes and calculate conservative verdicts
    Judge-->>Flow: Validated criteria and verdicts
    Flow-->>Pipe: Structured trial matches and evidence
    Pipe-->>Route: MatchResponse
    Route->>Store: Save search text and complete result to owned session
    Route-->>Client: JSON response with session ID
    Client-->>UI: Restore/display matches and criteria
```
