"""Download ~500 recruiting trials across 12 therapeutic areas via ClinicalTrials.gov API v2."""
import json
import re
import time
from collections import Counter

import requests
from app.config import settings

API = "https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies"
AREAS = ["breast cancer", "lung cancer", "colorectal cancer", "type 2 diabetes", "heart failure",
         "chronic kidney disease", "rheumatoid arthritis", "multiple sclerosis", "asthma COPD",
         "Alzheimer disease", "depression", "hepatitis HIV infection"]
PER_AREA = 42  # 12 x 42


def parse_age(s: str | None):
    if not s:
        return None
    m = re.match(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(year|month|week|day)", s.lower())
    if not m:
        return None
    v, unit = float(m.group(1)), m.group(2)
    return v / {"year": 1, "month": 12, "week": 52, "day": 365}[unit]


def flatten(study: dict) -> dict | None:
    p = study.get("protocolSection", {})
    ident, st, desc = p.get("identificationModule", {}), p.get("statusModule", {}), p.get("descriptionModule", {})
    el, dm, cm = p.get("eligibilityModule", {}), p.get("designModule", {}), p.get("conditionsModule", {})
    ai, cl, sp = p.get("armsInterventionsModule", {}), p.get("contactsLocationsModule", {}), p.get("sponsorCollaboratorsModule", {})
    refs = p.get("referencesModule", {}).get("references", [])
    if not el.get("eligibilityCriteria") or not desc.get("briefSummary"):
        return None
    return {
        "nct_id": ident["nctId"],
        "title": ident.get("briefTitle", ""),
        "official_title": ident.get("officialTitle", ""),
        "status": st.get("overallStatus", ""),
        "phases": dm.get("phases", []),
        "study_type": dm.get("studyType", ""),
        "conditions": cm.get("conditions", []),
        "keywords": cm.get("keywords", []),
        "brief_summary": desc["briefSummary"],
        "interventions": [i.get("name", "") for i in ai.get("interventions", [])],
        "eligibility_text": el["eligibilityCriteria"],
        "sex": el.get("sex", "ALL"),
        "min_age": el.get("minimumAge"), "max_age": el.get("maximumAge"),
        "min_age_years": parse_age(el.get("minimumAge")), "max_age_years": parse_age(el.get("maximumAge")),
        "healthy_volunteers": el.get("healthyVolunteers"),
        "sponsor": sp.get("leadSponsor", {}).get("name"),
        "locations": [f"{l.get('facility','')}, {l.get('city','')}, {l.get('country','')}".strip(", ")
                      for l in cl.get("locations", [])[:5]],
        "pmids": [r["pmid"] for r in refs if r.get("pmid")],
        "publications": [],
    }


def fetch_area(area: str, want: int, seen: set) -> list[dict]:
    out, token = [], None
    while len(out) < want:
        params = {"query.cond": area, "filter.overallStatus": "RECRUITING", "pageSize": 50, "format": "json"}
        if token:
            params["pageToken"] = token
        r = requests.get(API, params=params, timeout=60)
        r.raise_for_status()
        j = r.json()
        for s in j.get("studies", []):
            rec = flatten(s)
            if rec and rec["nct_id"] not in seen:
                seen.add(rec["nct_id"])
                out.append(rec)
                if len(out) >= want:
                    break
        token = j.get("nextPageToken")
        if not token:
            break
        time.sleep(0.3)
    return out


def profile_data(trials: list[dict]):
    print(f"\nTrials: {len(trials)}")
    print("Phases:", Counter(p for t in trials for p in (t["phases"] or ["NA"])).most_common())
    print("Sex:", Counter(t["sex"] for t in trials))
    print("Has explicit exclusion section:",
          sum(bool(re.search(r"exclusion criteria", t["eligibility_text"], re.I)) for t in trials))
    lens = sorted(len(t["eligibility_text"]) for t in trials)
    print(f"Eligibility chars  median={lens[len(lens)//2]}  max={lens[-1]}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    settings.raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    settings.processed_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    seen, trials = set(), []
    for area in AREAS:
        got = fetch_area(area, PER_AREA, seen)
        print(f"{area}: {len(got)}")
        trials.extend(got)
    trials = trials[:500]
    with open(settings.processed_dir / "trials.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(trials, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    profile_data(trials)


========== FILE: backend\ingestion\chunker.py ==========

import re

MAX_CHARS = 1800


def split_eligibility(text: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    m = re.search(r"exclusion criteria\s*:?", text, re.I)
    if m:
        return text[: m.start()].strip(), text[m.end():].strip()
    return text.strip(), ""


def window(text: str, size: int = MAX_CHARS) -> list[str]:
    out, cur = [], ""
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        if cur and len(cur) + len(line) + 1 > size:
            out.append(cur.strip())
            cur = ""
        cur += line + "\n"
    if cur.strip():
        out.append(cur.strip())
    return out


def chunk_trial(t: dict) -> list[dict]:
    head = f"Trial: {t['title']}\nConditions: {', '.join(t['conditions'])}\n"
    chunks = [{
        "id": f"{t['nct_id']}::overview::0", "nct_id": t["nct_id"], "type": "overview",
        "text": head + f"Phase: {', '.join(t['phases']) or 'N/A'}\n"
                       f"Interventions: {', '.join(t['interventions'][:8])}\nSummary: {t['brief_summary'][:1500]}",
    }]
    inc, exc = split_eligibility(t["eligibility_text"])
    for kind, body in (("inclusion", inc), ("exclusion", exc)):
        for i, piece in enumerate(window(body) if body else []):
            chunks.append({"id": f"{t['nct_id']}::{kind}::{i}", "nct_id": t["nct_id"], "type": kind,
                           "text": head + f"{kind.upper()} CRITERIA:\n{piece}"})
    for i, pub in enumerate(t.get("publications", [])):
        chunks.append({"id": f"{t['nct_id']}::publication::{i}", "nct_id": t["nct_id"], "type": "publication",
                       "text": head + f"Publication ({pub['pmcid']}): {pub['title']}\n{pub['abstract'][:1500]}"})
    return chunks


========== FILE: backend\ingestion\build_index.py ==========

"""BigQuery Vector Search Table and Index Initializer.

Initializes the BigQuery dataset and trial_chunks table.
In BigQuery, exact brute-force vector search requires NO vector index or
deployed endpoint. An optional vector index can be created later via:
`CREATE VECTOR INDEX ...` when table size scales beyond tens of thousands of chunks.
"""
import logging
from google.cloud import bigquery
from google.cloud.exceptions import NotFound

from app.config import settings

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("build_index")


def init_bigquery_resources(create_index: bool = False) -> None:
    """Initialize BigQuery dataset and trial_chunks table."""
    client = bigquery.Client(project=settings.gcp_project, location=settings.bq_location)
    dataset_ref = bigquery.DatasetReference(settings.gcp_project, settings.bigquery_dataset)

    # 1. Dataset
    try:
        client.get_dataset(dataset_ref)
        logger.info(f"Dataset '{settings.bigquery_dataset}' already exists in location '{settings.bq_location}'.")
    except NotFound:
        logger.info(f"Creating dataset '{settings.bigquery_dataset}' in location '{settings.bq_location}'...")
        ds = bigquery.Dataset(dataset_ref)
        ds.location = settings.bq_location
        ds.description = "Clinical Trial RAG embeddings, chunks, and metadata"
        client.create_dataset(ds)
        logger.info(f"Created dataset '{settings.bigquery_dataset}'.")

    # 2. Table
    table_ref = dataset_ref.table(settings.bigquery_chunks_table)
    schema = [
        bigquery.SchemaField("chunk_id", "STRING", mode="REQUIRED", description="Unique chunk ID"),
        bigquery.SchemaField("nct_id", "STRING", mode="REQUIRED", description="NCT identifier"),
        bigquery.SchemaField("chunk_text", "STRING", mode="REQUIRED", description="Text content"),
        bigquery.SchemaField("chunk_type", "STRING", mode="NULLABLE", description="Type of chunk"),
        bigquery.SchemaField("embedding", "FLOAT64", mode="REPEATED", description="Dense embedding vector"),
        bigquery.SchemaField("metadata_json", "STRING", mode="NULLABLE", description="JSON trial metadata"),
    ]

    try:
        table = client.get_table(table_ref)
        logger.info(f"Table '{settings.bigquery_chunks_table}' already exists.")
    except NotFound:
        logger.info(f"Creating table '{settings.bigquery_chunks_table}'...")
        table = bigquery.Table(table_ref, schema=schema)
        table.description = "Stores trial chunk texts and dense vector embeddings for vector search"
        table = client.create_table(table)
        logger.info(f"Created table '{settings.bigquery_chunks_table}'.")

    logger.info("BigQuery resources initialized successfully.")
    logger.info("Exact brute-force vector search is ready without deploying an endpoint.")

    # 3. Optional Approximate Nearest Neighbor Vector Index (Opt-in)
    if create_index:
        logger.info("Creating optional BigQuery vector index...")
        sql = f"""
        CREATE VECTOR INDEX IF NOT EXISTS trial_chunks_vector_idx
        ON `{table_ref.project}.{table_ref.dataset_id}.{table_ref.table_id}`(embedding)
        OPTIONS(distance_type='COSINE', index_type='IVF');
        """
        job = client.query(sql, location=settings.bq_location)
        job.result()
        logger.info("BigQuery vector index created.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    init_bigquery_resources(create_index=False)


========== FILE: backend\ingestion\ingest.py ==========

"""Ingestion script for Clinical Trial RAG.

Chunks trials, generates dense vector embeddings via Vertex AI Embeddings,
and stores chunk records in Google Cloud BigQuery. It also updates the local
chunks.json cache and uploads trials.json and chunks.json to GCS when configured.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import logging
import math
import sys
from typing import Any

from google.cloud import bigquery
from google.cloud.exceptions import NotFound

from app.config import settings
from app.services import gcs_store
from app.services.embeddings import embed
from ingestion.chunker import chunk_trial

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s",
)
logger = logging.getLogger("ingest")


def get_bigquery_table_ref(client: bigquery.Client) -> bigquery.TableReference:
    """Return the BigQuery TableReference for the trial_chunks table."""
    dataset_ref = bigquery.DatasetReference(
        settings.gcp_project,
        settings.bigquery_dataset,
    )
    return dataset_ref.table(settings.bigquery_chunks_table)


def ensure_table_exists(client: bigquery.Client) -> bigquery.Table:
    """Ensure the dataset and trial_chunks table exist in BigQuery."""
    dataset_ref = bigquery.DatasetReference(
        settings.gcp_project,
        settings.bigquery_dataset,
    )

    try:
        client.get_dataset(dataset_ref)
    except NotFound:
        logger.info(
            "Dataset %s not found. Creating in %s...",
            settings.bigquery_dataset,
            settings.bq_location,
        )
        dataset = bigquery.Dataset(dataset_ref)
        dataset.location = settings.bq_location
        client.create_dataset(dataset, exists_ok=True)
        logger.info("Dataset %s created.", settings.bigquery_dataset)

    table_ref = get_bigquery_table_ref(client)
    schema = [
        bigquery.SchemaField(
            "chunk_id", "STRING", mode="REQUIRED",
            description="Unique chunk ID",
        ),
        bigquery.SchemaField(
            "nct_id", "STRING", mode="REQUIRED",
            description="NCT identifier",
        ),
        bigquery.SchemaField(
            "chunk_text", "STRING", mode="REQUIRED",
            description="Text content",
        ),
        bigquery.SchemaField(
            "chunk_type", "STRING", mode="NULLABLE",
            description="overview/inclusion/exclusion/publication",
        ),
        bigquery.SchemaField(
            "embedding", "FLOAT64", mode="REPEATED",
            description="Dense embedding vector",
        ),
        bigquery.SchemaField(
            "metadata_json", "STRING", mode="NULLABLE",
            description="JSON trial metadata",
        ),
    ]

    try:
        table = client.get_table(table_ref)
        logger.info("Found existing BigQuery table: %s", table_ref.path)
        return table
    except NotFound:
        logger.info("Creating BigQuery table: %s...", table_ref.path)
        table = bigquery.Table(table_ref, schema=schema)
        table = client.create_table(table)
        logger.info("Created table %s", table_ref.path)
        return table


def validate_records(
    records: list[dict[str, Any]],
    expected_dim: int,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Validate each chunk and embedding record."""
    valid: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    rejected: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for record in records:
        chunk_id = record.get("chunk_id")
        nct_id = record.get("nct_id")
        text = record.get("chunk_text")
        embedding = record.get("embedding")

        if not chunk_id or not nct_id or not text or not text.strip():
            logger.warning(
                "Rejecting record %s: missing ID, NCT, or text.",
                chunk_id,
            )
            rejected.append({
                "record": record,
                "reason": "Missing required field or empty text",
            })
            continue

        if (
            not isinstance(embedding, (list, tuple))
            or len(embedding) != expected_dim
        ):
            dimension = len(embedding) if embedding else 0
            logger.warning(
                "Rejecting record %s: invalid embedding dimension %s.",
                chunk_id,
                dimension,
            )
            rejected.append({
                "record": record,
                "reason": f"Dimension mismatch (expected {expected_dim})",
            })
            continue

        if any(
            value is None or not math.isfinite(value)
            for value in embedding
        ):
            logger.warning(
                "Rejecting record %s: embedding contains NaN, Inf, or None.",
                chunk_id,
            )
            rejected.append({
                "record": record,
                "reason": "Non-finite values in embedding",
            })
            continue

        valid.append(record)

    return valid, rejected


def get_existing_chunk_ids(
    client: bigquery.Client,
    table_ref: bigquery.TableReference,
) -> set[str]:
    """Fetch existing chunk IDs from BigQuery to prevent duplicate processing."""
    query = (
        f"SELECT chunk_id FROM "
        f"`{table_ref.project}.{table_ref.dataset_id}.{table_ref.table_id}`"
    )
    try:
        query_job = client.query(query, location=settings.bq_location)
        return {row.chunk_id for row in query_job}
    except Exception:
        # Fail closed: do not regenerate embeddings or append duplicates if
        # BigQuery cannot be checked successfully.
        logger.exception("Could not fetch existing chunk IDs; stopping ingestion.")
        raise


def upload_processed_json_to_gcs(filename: str) -> str:
    """Upload a processed local JSON file through gcs_store.write_json()."""
    file_path = settings.processed_dir / filename
    if not file_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Processed JSON file not found: {file_path}")

    with file_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
        data = json.load(file)

    # write_json accepts a Python object, not a local file path.
    return gcs_store.write_json(filename, data)


def run_ingestion(refresh: bool = False, batch_size: int = 100) -> None:
    """Read trials, create chunks, embed new chunks, store in BigQuery, upload JSON."""
    if batch_size < 1:
        raise ValueError("batch_size must be at least 1.")

    trials_path = settings.processed_dir / "trials.json"
    if not trials_path.is_file():
        logger.error(
            "Source trials file not found at %s. Run fetch_trials.py first.",
            trials_path,
        )
        sys.exit(1)

    with trials_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
        trials = json.load(file)

    # 1. Create chunks from the source trials.
    all_chunks = [
        chunk
        for trial in trials
        for chunk in chunk_trial(trial)
    ]
    logger.info("Loaded %s trials -> %s chunks.", len(trials), len(all_chunks))

    client = bigquery.Client(
        project=settings.gcp_project,
        location=settings.bq_location,
    )

    try:
        table = ensure_table_exists(client)
        table_ref = table.reference

        # 2. Skip chunks already stored in BigQuery unless --refresh is explicit.
        if refresh:
            logger.warning(
                "Explicit --refresh flag specified: full table refresh requested."
            )
            chunks_to_process = all_chunks
        else:
            existing_ids = get_existing_chunk_ids(client, table_ref)
            chunks_to_process = [
                chunk for chunk in all_chunks
                if chunk["id"] not in existing_ids
            ]
            skipped_count = len(all_chunks) - len(chunks_to_process)
            logger.info(
                "Duplicate check: %s chunks exist in BigQuery; "
                "%s already present, %s new chunks to embed.",
                len(existing_ids),
                skipped_count,
                len(chunks_to_process),
            )

        valid_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        # 3. Generate embeddings only for chunks not already in BigQuery.
        if chunks_to_process:
            logger.info(
                "Generating embeddings via Vertex AI for %s chunks...",
                len(chunks_to_process),
            )
            chunk_texts = [chunk["text"] for chunk in chunks_to_process]
            vectors: list[list[float]] = []

            for start in range(0, len(chunk_texts), batch_size):
                batch = chunk_texts[start:start + batch_size]
                batch_vectors = embed(batch, task_type="RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT")

                if len(batch_vectors) != len(batch):
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "Embedding count does not match batch size; "
                        "stopping before BigQuery insertion."
                    )

                vectors.extend(batch_vectors)
                logger.info(
                    "Embedded %s/%s chunks.",
                    min(start + len(batch), len(chunk_texts)),
                    len(chunk_texts),
                )

            trial_map = {
                trial["nct_id"]: trial
                for trial in trials
                if trial.get("nct_id")
            }
            records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

            for chunk, vector in zip(chunks_to_process, vectors):
                trial = trial_map.get(chunk["nct_id"], {})
                metadata = {
                    "title": trial.get("title", ""),
                    "status": trial.get("status", ""),
                    "phases": trial.get("phases", []),
                    "conditions": trial.get("conditions", []),
                    "sponsor": trial.get("sponsor"),
                    "study_url": (
                        "https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/"
                        f"{trial.get('nct_id', '')}"
                    ),
                }
                records.append({
                    "chunk_id": chunk["id"],
                    "nct_id": chunk["nct_id"],
                    "chunk_text": chunk["text"],
                    "chunk_type": chunk.get("type", "overview"),
                    "embedding": vector,
                    "metadata_json": json.dumps(
                        metadata,
                        ensure_ascii=False,
                    ),
                })

            # 4. Validate all generated records before insertion.
            valid_records, rejected_records = validate_records(
                records,
                expected_dim=settings.embedding_dim,
            )
            logger.info(
                "Validation: %s valid records, %s rejected records.",
                len(valid_records),
                len(rejected_records),
            )

            if rejected_records:
                logger.warning(
                    "%s records were rejected and will not be inserted.",
                    len(rejected_records),
                )

            if not valid_records:
                logger.error("No valid records to write to BigQuery. Aborting.")
                return
        else:
            logger.info(
                "All chunks already exist in BigQuery. "
                "Skipping embedding generation and insertion."
            )

        # 5. Insert records. Full table refresh happens only with --refresh.
        if valid_records:
            write_disposition = (
                bigquery.WriteDisposition.WRITE_TRUNCATE
                if refresh
                else bigquery.WriteDisposition.WRITE_APPEND
            )
            logger.info(
                "Loading %s chunks into BigQuery `%s.%s.%s`...",
                len(valid_records),
                table_ref.project,
                table_ref.dataset_id,
                table_ref.table_id,
            )
            job_config = bigquery.LoadJobConfig(
                schema=table.schema,
                write_disposition=write_disposition,
            )
            load_job = client.load_table_from_json(
                valid_records,
                table_ref,
                job_config=job_config,
            )
            load_job.result()
            logger.info(
                "Successfully loaded %s chunks into BigQuery.",
                len(valid_records),
            )
        else:
            logger.info("No new records to insert into BigQuery.")

        # 6. Update local chunks.json cache.
        chunks_metadata = {
            chunk["id"]: {
                "nct_id": chunk["nct_id"],
                "type": chunk.get("type", "overview"),
                "text": chunk["text"],
            }
            for chunk in all_chunks
        }
        chunks_path = settings.processed_dir / "chunks.json"
        with chunks_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
            json.dump(chunks_metadata, file, ensure_ascii=False)
        logger.info("Updated local chunks cache at %s.", chunks_path)

        # 7. Upload processed JSON files to GCS using the implemented helper.
        if settings.gcs_bucket:
            for filename in ("trials.json", "chunks.json"):
                try:
                    object_name = upload_processed_json_to_gcs(filename)
                    logger.info("Uploaded %s to GCS: %s", filename, object_name)
                except Exception:
                    logger.exception(
                        "GCS upload failed for %s. BigQuery processing has "
                        "already completed; fix the GCS issue and retry upload.",
                        filename,
                    )
                    raise
        else:
            logger.info("GCS_BUCKET is not configured; skipping GCS uploads.")

        logger.info("Ingestion completed successfully.")
    finally:
        client.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Ingest clinical trials into BigQuery and GCS."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--refresh",
        action="store_true",
        help=(
            "Explicitly truncate and reload all chunks in BigQuery. "
            "May regenerate embeddings and replace existing table rows."
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--batch-size",
        type=int,
        default=100,
        help="Number of chunks per embedding batch.",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    run_ingestion(refresh=args.refresh, batch_size=args.batch_size)

function ClinicalWorkspace({ authUser, onLogout }) {
  const displayName = (
    authUser.profile.displayName
    || authUser.firebaseUser.displayName
    || authUser.firebaseUser.email?.split("@")[0]
    || "Clinical Technician"
  ).trim();
  const {
    sessions,
    activeSessionId,
    activeSession,
    switchSession,
    createNewSession,
    updateSession,
    updateActiveSession,
    renameSession,
    deleteSession,
    clearAllSessions,
    loading: sessionsLoading,
    loadingSessionId,
    error: sessionsError,
  } = useSessionManager(authUser);

  const { toast, showToast, hideToast } = useToast();

  // Local state bound to active session
  const [patientText, setPatientText] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [matchStep, setMatchStep] = useState(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [isSidebarOpen, setIsSidebarOpen] = useState(() => (
    typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia("(min-width: 1024px)").matches
  ));
  const [isChatOpen, setIsChatOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAssessmentPageOpen, setIsAssessmentPageOpen] = useState(false);
  const [healthStatus, setHealthStatus] = useState("checking");
  const [trialCount, setTrialCount] = useState(0);

  const resultsRef = useRef(null);
  const patientInputRef = useRef(null);

  const handleStartSearch = () => {
    patientInputRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
    window.setTimeout(() => patientInputRef.current?.focus(), 250);
  };

  const handleOpenAssessment = () => {
    if (!activeSession?.data) return;
    setIsChatOpen(false);
    setIsAssessmentPageOpen(true);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  const handleBackToResults = () => {
    setIsAssessmentPageOpen(false);
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      resultsRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }, 0);
  };

  // Sync local text input when active session changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSession) {
      setPatientText(activeSession.patientCase || "");
      setError("");
      setIsAssessmentPageOpen(false);
    }
  }, [activeSession?.id, activeSession?.patientCase]);

  // Check backend health on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    checkHealth()
      .then((res) => {
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (res && res.status === "ok") {
          setHealthStatus("online");
          if (Number.isFinite(res.trials_indexed)) setTrialCount(res.trials_indexed);
        } else {
          setHealthStatus("offline");
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (mounted) setHealthStatus("offline");
      });

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Step ticker animation during loading
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading) {
      setMatchStep(0);
      return undefined;
    }

    setMatchStep(0);
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setMatchStep((prev) => Math.min(prev + 1, MATCH_STEPS.length - 1));
    }, 4500);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [loading]);

  // Handle case submission
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    const cleanCase = patientText.trim();
    if (cleanCase.length < 40 || loading) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      if (!activeSessionId || !activeSession) throw new Error("Your session is still loading. Please try again.");
      let searchSession = activeSession;
      if (activeSession.data) {
        const title = `Trial search Â· ${new Date().toLocaleString([], { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" })}`;
        searchSession = await createNewSession(title);
      }
      updateSession(searchSession.id, { patientCase: cleanCase, touch: true });
      const result = await matchPatient(cleanCase, searchSession.id);

      if (!result || !Array.isArray(result.matches)) {
        throw new Error("Invalid response format received from matching service.");
      }

      updateSession(searchSession.id, {
        patientCase: cleanCase,
        data: result,
        activeTab: 0,
      });

      showToast(
        `Retrieved and evaluated ${result.matches.length} candidate trials`,
        "success"
      );

      // Smooth scroll to results
      setTimeout(() => {
        resultsRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: "smooth",
          block: "start",
        });
      }, 150);
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err?.message || "Failed to match clinical trials.";
      setError(msg);
      showToast(msg, "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTextChange = (e) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setPatientText(val);
    updateActiveSession({ patientCase: val });
  };

  const handleLoadSample = () => {
    setPatientText(SAMPLE_CASE);
    updateActiveSession({ patientCase: SAMPLE_CASE });
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      patientInputRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
      patientInputRef.current?.focus();
    }, 0);
    showToast("Loaded sample NSCLC clinical case", "info");
  };

  const handleClearCase = async () => {
    setPatientText("");
    if (activeSessionId) {
      try {
        await clearRemoteResult(activeSessionId);
      } catch (clearError) {
        showToast(clearError.message || "Could not clear the saved result.", "error");
      }
    }
    updateActiveSession({ patientCase: "", data: null });
  };

  const handleSelectTab = (index) => {
    updateActiveSession({ activeTab: index });
  };

  const handleUpdateChatHistory = (newHistory) => {
    updateActiveSession({ chatHistory: newHistory });
  };

  const handleCopySummary = () => {
    if (!activeSession?.data?.matches) return;
    const matches = activeSession.data.matches;
    const lines = [
      `Clinical Trial Match Summary (${matches.length} candidate trials)`,
      `Session: ${activeSession.title}`,
      `Date: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}`,
      "",
      ...matches.map(
        (m, i) =>
          `#${i + 1} [${m.verdict}] ${m.nct_id}: ${m.title} (Match: ${Math.round(
            (m.relevance_score || 0) * 100
          )}%)`
      ),
    ];
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(lines.join("\n")).catch(() => {});
    showToast("Summary copied to clipboard", "success");
  };

  const currentData = activeSession?.data || null;
  const currentMatches = currentData?.matches || [];
  const currentActiveTab = Math.min(
    activeSession?.activeTab || 0,
    Math.max(0, currentMatches.length - 1)
  );
  const selectedMatch = currentMatches[currentActiveTab] || null;

  return (
    <AppShell
      isSidebarOpen={isSidebarOpen}
      header={
        <Header
          healthStatus={healthStatus}
          trialCount={trialCount}
          sessionCount={sessions.length}
          isSidebarOpen={isSidebarOpen}
          onToggleSidebar={() => setIsSidebarOpen(!isSidebarOpen)}
          onNewSession={() => {
            createNewSession()
              .then(() => showToast("Started a new patient matching session", "info"))
              .catch((err) => showToast(err.message || "Could not start a session.", "error"));
          }}
          hasAssessment={Boolean(currentData) && !isAssessmentPageOpen}
          onOpenAssessment={handleOpenAssessment}
          displayName={displayName}
          onLogout={onLogout}
        />
      }
      sidebar={
        <SessionSidebar
          isOpen={isSidebarOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsSidebarOpen(false)}
          sessions={sessions}
          activeSessionId={activeSessionId}
          onSelectSession={(id) => {
            switchSession(id).then((opened) => {
              if (opened) showToast("Loaded session", "info");
            });
          }}
          onNewSession={() => {
            createNewSession()
              .then(() => showToast("Started a new session", "info"))
              .catch((err) => showToast(err.message || "Could not start a session.", "error"));
          }}
          onRenameSession={(id, title) => {
            renameSession(id, title);
            showToast("Session renamed", "success");
          }}
          onDeleteSession={(id) => {
            deleteSession(id);
            showToast("Session removed", "info");
          }}
          onClearAllSessions={() => {
            clearAllSessions();
            showToast("All sessions cleared", "info");
          }}
        />
      }
      footer={<Footer />}
    >
      {/* â”€â”€ Main Input Card â”€â”€ */}
      {isAssessmentPageOpen && currentData ? (
        <ClinicalAssessmentPage
          data={currentData}
          patientCase={patientText}
          sessionTitle={activeSession?.title}
          onBack={handleBackToResults}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
      <WorkspaceWelcome
        displayName={displayName}
        healthStatus={healthStatus}
        trialCount={trialCount}
        sessionCount={sessions.length}
        recentSessions={sessions}
        onOpenSession={(id) => switchSession(id)}
        onStartSearch={handleStartSearch}
        onLoadSample={handleLoadSample}
        actionsDisabled={sessionsLoading}
      />

      <section className="input-panel-section">
        {(sessionsLoading || loadingSessionId) && <div className="session-loading-note" role="status">{loadingSessionId ? "Opening your saved sessionâ€¦" : "Loading your secure sessionsâ€¦"}</div>}
        {sessionsError && <div className="auth-alert" role="alert">{sessionsError}</div>}
        <div className="section-header-row">
          <div>
            <span className="section-eyebrow">PATIENT CASE INTAKE</span>
            <h2 className="section-heading">Clinical Narrative Analysis</h2>
            <p className="section-subtext">
              Enter an anonymized clinical note (age, sex, histology, stage, biomarkers, prior therapies, comorbidities, and laboratory values).

/**
 * API service for communicating with the FastAPI backend.
 */

import { auth } from "./firebase";

export const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "";

/**
 * @typedef {Object} MatchResponse
 * @property {Object} patient_profile
 * @property {Array<Object>} matches
 * @property {string} disclaimer
 * @property {number} latency_seconds
 * @property {string|null} [emergency_notice] Present when urgent screening stops matching.
 * @property {string[]} [missing_key_facts] Plain-language facts absent from the validated profile.
 * @property {string[]} [conflicting_facts] Conflicts detected in supported case text.
 * @property {Array<{nct_id: string, title: string, reason: string}>} [ruled_out_trials]
 * @property {string|null} [result_message] Search-specific empty-state explanation.
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} ChatResponse
 * @property {string} answer
 * @property {Array<Object>} citations
 * @property {string|null} missing_info
 * @property {string|null} session_id Client-provided identifier; not server-side memory.
 */

async function request(endpoint, options = {}) {
  let response;

  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
      ...options,
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        ...(auth?.currentUser
          ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${await auth.currentUser.getIdToken()}` }
          : {}),
        ...options.headers,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(
      "Cannot connect to the backend server. Please verify that FastAPI is running on http://localhost:8000."
    );
  }

  const raw = await response.text();
  let data;

  try {
    data = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      `The server returned an invalid response: ${raw.slice(0, 200)}`
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = data?.detail || data?.message || raw;
    throw new Error(
      typeof detail === "string" ? detail : JSON.stringify(detail)
    );
  }

  return data;
}

/**
 * Match a de-identified patient case against clinical trials.
 * @param {string} patientCase
 * @returns {Promise<MatchResponse>}
 */
export async function matchPatient(patientCase, sessionId) {
  if (!patientCase || !patientCase.trim()) {
    throw new Error("Please enter a patient case before matching trials.");
  }

  return request("/api/match", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({
      patient_case: patientCase.trim(),
      session_id: sessionId || null,
    }),
  });
}

/**
 * Ask a follow-up question grounded strictly in the retrieved trials.
 * @param {Object} params
 * @param {string} params.question
 * @param {Array<string>} params.trialIds
 * @param {string} [params.patientCase]
 * @param {string} [params.sessionId]
 * @returns {Promise<ChatResponse>}
 */
export async function askTrialQuestion({
  question,
  trialIds,
  patientCase = null,
  sessionId = null,
  messageId = null,
}) {
  if (!question || !question.trim()) {
    throw new Error("Please enter a question.");
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(trialIds) || trialIds.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("At least one trial ID is required for Q&A.");
  }

  return request("/api/trials/chat", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({
      question: question.trim(),
      trial_ids: trialIds,
      session_id: sessionId || null,
      message_id: messageId || null,
    }),
  });
}

/**
 * Check backend health & trial indexing status.
 * @returns {Promise<{status: string, trials_indexed?: number}>}
 */
export async function checkHealth() {
  try {
    return await request("/api/health", { method: "GET" });
  } catch {
    return { status: "offline", trials_indexed: 0 };
  }
}

export async function initializeProfile(displayName) {
  return request("/api/auth/profile", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ display_name: displayName }),
  });
}

export async function listSessions() {
  return request("/api/sessions", { method: "GET" });
}

export async function createSession(title = "New Patient Session") {
  return request("/api/sessions", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ title }),
  });
}

export async function getSession(sessionId) {
  return request(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`, { method: "GET" });
}

export async function renameRemoteSession(sessionId, title) {
  return request(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`, {
    method: "PATCH",
    body: JSON.stringify({ title }),
  });
}

export async function deleteRemoteSession(sessionId) {
  return request(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

export async function clearRemoteSessions() {
  return request("/api/sessions", { method: "DELETE" });
}

export async function clearRemoteChat(sessionId) {
  return request(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}/messages`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

export async function clearRemoteResult(sessionId) {
  return request(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}/result`, { method: "DELETE" });
}

export default {
  matchPatient,
  askTrialQuestion,
  checkHealth,
  initializeProfile,
  listSessions,
  createSession,
  getSession,
  renameRemoteSession,
  deleteRemoteSession,
  clearRemoteSessions,
  clearRemoteChat,
  clearRemoteResult,
};

========== FILE: frontend\src\auth\AuthContext.jsx ==========

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword,
  onAuthStateChanged,
  signInWithEmailAndPassword,
  signOut,
  updateProfile,
} from "firebase/auth";
import { API_BASE, initializeProfile } from "../api";
import { auth, isFirebaseConfigured } from "../firebase";

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

async function loadProfile(firebaseUser) {
  const token = await firebaseUser.getIdToken();
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/profile`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(response.status === 503
      ? "User profile storage is unavailable. Check Firebase Admin and Firestore setup."
      : "Could not load your user profile. Please retry sign-in.");
  }
  return response.json();
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!auth) {
      setLoading(false);
      return undefined;
    }
    let mounted = true;
    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (firebaseUser) => {
      setUser(null);
      setError("");
      if (!firebaseUser) {
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const profile = await loadProfile(firebaseUser);
        if (mounted) setUser({ firebaseUser, profile });
      } catch (loadError) {
        if (mounted) setError(loadError.message || "Could not load your profile.");
      } finally {
        if (mounted) setLoading(false);
      }
    });
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({
    user,
    loading,
    error,
    configured: isFirebaseConfigured,
    signIn: (email, password) => signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password),
    signUp: async (displayName, email, password) => {
      const credential = await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
      await updateProfile(credential.user, { displayName });
      await credential.user.getIdToken(true);
      const profile = await initializeProfile(displayName);
      setUser({ firebaseUser: credential.user, profile });
      return credential;
    },
    signOut: () => signOut(auth),
    retryProfile: async () => {
      if (!auth?.currentUser) return;
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");
      try {
        const profile = await loadProfile(auth.currentUser);
        setUser({ firebaseUser: auth.currentUser, profile });
      } catch (loadError) {
        setError(loadError.message || "Could not load your profile.");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
  }), [user, loading, error]);

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth() {
  const value = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!value) throw new Error("useAuth must be used within AuthProvider.");
  return value;
}

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import {

function normalizeSession(session) {
  return {
    id: session.id,
    title: session.title || "New Patient Session",
    patientCase: session.searchQuery || "",
    data: session.data || null,
    activeTab: 0,
    chatHistory: session.chatHistory || [],
    createdAt: session.createdAt || Date.now(),
    updatedAt: session.updatedAt || Date.now(),
  };
}

export function useSessionManager(user) {
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState([]);
  const [activeSessionId, setActiveSessionId] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loadingSessionId, setLoadingSessionId] = useState(null);
  const switchRequest = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    clearAllStorage(); // remove legacy per-tab cases/chat before loading user data
    setSessions([]);
    setActiveSessionId(null);
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    (async () => {
      try {
        let loaded = await listSessions();
        if (!Array.isArray(loaded)) loaded = [];
        if (loaded.length === 0) {
          loaded = [await createRemoteSession()];
        }
        if (!mounted) return;
        const normalized = loaded.map(normalizeSession);
        setSessions(normalized);
        const first = normalized[0];
        setActiveSessionId(first.id);
        const details = await getSession(first.id);
        if (mounted) {
          setSessions((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === first.id
            ? { ...item, ...normalizeSession(details) }
            : item));
        }
      } catch (loadError) {
        if (mounted) setError(loadError.message || "Could not load saved sessions.");
      } finally {
        if (mounted) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, [user?.firebaseUser?.uid]);

  const activeSession = useMemo(
    () => sessions.find((session) => session.id === activeSessionId) || null,
    [sessions, activeSessionId],
  );

  const switchSession = useCallback(async (id) => {
    const requestId = ++switchRequest.current;
    setLoadingSessionId(id);
    setError("");
    try {
      const detail = await getSession(id);
      if (requestId !== switchRequest.current) return;
      setSessions((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === id
        ? { ...item, ...normalizeSession(detail) }
        : item));
      setActiveSessionId(id);
      return true;
    } catch (loadError) {
      if (requestId === switchRequest.current) setError(loadError.message || "Could not open this session.");
      return false;
    } finally {
      if (requestId === switchRequest.current) setLoadingSessionId(null);
    }
  }, []);

  const createNewSession = useCallback(async (title) => {
    switchRequest.current += 1;
    setLoadingSessionId(null);
    setError("");
    try {
      const created = normalizeSession(await createRemoteSession(title));
      setSessions((current) => [created, ...current]);
      setActiveSessionId(created.id);
      setError("");
      return created;
    } catch (createError) {
      setError(createError.message || "Could not create a session.");
      throw createError;
    }
  }, []);

  const updateSession = useCallback((id, patch) => {
    if (!id) return;
    const { touch = false, ...sessionPatch } = patch;
    setSessions((current) => {
      const next = current.map((session) => {
        if (session.id !== id) return session;
        const updated = { ...session, ...sessionPatch, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        if (sessionPatch.title && sessionPatch.title !== session.title) {
          renameRemoteSession(id, sessionPatch.title).catch((renameError) => {
            setError(renameError.message || "Could not save the session name.");
          });
        }
        return updated;
      });
      if (touch || sessionPatch.data || sessionPatch.chatHistory || sessionPatch.title) {
        next.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime());
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const updateActiveSession = useCallback((patch) => {
    updateSession(activeSessionId, patch);
  }, [activeSessionId, updateSession]);

  const renameSession = useCallback(async (id, title) => {
    const cleanTitle = title?.trim().slice(0, 100);
    if (!cleanTitle) return;
    try {
      await renameRemoteSession(id, cleanTitle);
      setSessions((current) => {
        const renamed = current.map((item) => item.id === id
          ? { ...item, title: cleanTitle, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
          : item);
        return renamed.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime());
      });
    } catch (renameError) {
      setError(renameError.message || "Could not rename this session.");
    }
  }, []);

  const deleteSession = useCallback(async (id) => {
    try {
      await deleteRemoteSession(id);
      let remaining = sessions.filter((item) => item.id !== id);
      if (remaining.length === 0) remaining = [normalizeSession(await createRemoteSession())];
      setSessions(remaining);
      if (activeSessionId === id) setActiveSessionId(remaining[0].id);
    } catch (deleteError) {
      setError(deleteError.message || "Could not delete this session.");
    }
  }, [sessions, activeSessionId]);

  const clearAllSessions = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await clearRemoteSessions();
      const fresh = normalizeSession(await createRemoteSession());
      setSessions([fresh]);
      setActiveSessionId(fresh.id);
    } catch (clearError) {
      setError(clearError.message || "Could not clear saved sessions.");
    }
  }, []);

  return {
    sessions,
    activeSessionId,
    activeSession,
    loading,
    loadingSessionId,
    error,
    switchSession,
    createNewSession,
    updateActiveSession,
    updateSession,
    renameSession,
    deleteSession,
    clearAllSessions,
  };
}



========== FILE: deploy\README.md ==========

# Cloud Run deployment

This project deploys as two Cloud Run services: the FastAPI API and the React static application. The deployment script uses Cloud Build from the Dockerfiles and keeps the local Firebase web configuration in ignored `frontend/.env`.

## Prerequisites

1. Install Google Cloud CLI, Node.js 20+, and npm.
2. Sign in with `gcloud auth login` and use an account allowed to deploy Cloud Run services, use Cloud Build and Artifact Registry, and enable APIs in the target project.
3. Configure `frontend/.env` using `frontend/.env.example`. Do not commit this file. Set the Firebase web app values for the Firebase project already used by the application.
4. Configure `backend/.env` with the GCP project that owns the existing BigQuery dataset, Vertex AI access, and optional GCS trial data. The script reads `GCP_PROJECT` from this ignored file; it defaults to the Cloud Run project if absent.

## Deploy

From the repository root in PowerShell:

```powershell
./deploy/deploy-cloud-run.ps1
```

The default Cloud Run target is `quiet-terminal-422106` in `us-central1`. Override the project, region, service names, and runtime service account as needed:

```powershell
./deploy/deploy-cloud-run.ps1 -ProjectId "your-cloud-run-project" -Region "us-central1" -RuntimeServiceAccount "clinical-trial-runtime@your-cloud-run-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

The script deploys the API first, builds the frontend with that API URL, deploys the web service, then sets API CORS to the web service origin. Both services are internet reachable so users can load the UI and Firebase-authenticated requests can reach the API. Protected API endpoints still verify Firebase ID tokens.

## Runtime identity permissions

Cloud Run uses its runtime service account and Application Default Credentials; do not upload a service-account key. Grant the runtime identity only the roles needed for configured services:

- Firestore access in the Firebase project used by `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` (typically `roles/datastore.user`).
- BigQuery job execution and read access to the configured dataset (typically `roles/bigquery.jobUser` and dataset-level `roles/bigquery.dataViewer`).
- Vertex AI model access in the project configured by `GCP_PROJECT` (typically `roles/aiplatform.user`).
- `roles/storage.objectViewer` on the trial-data bucket only when `GCS_BUCKET` is configured.

If Firebase, BigQuery, Vertex AI, or GCS belongs to another project, grant access on that resource's project. Keep `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` and `GCP_PROJECT` set to the projects that own those resources; they do not have to match the Cloud Run deployment project.

After deployment, open the printed web URL and check the printed `/api/ready` URL. Read API logs with:

```powershell
gcloud run services logs read clinical-trial-api --project quiet-terminal-422106 --region us-central1
```



========== FILE: deploy\deploy-cloud-run.ps1 ==========

param(
    [string]$ProjectId = "quiet-terminal-422106",
    [string]$Region = "us-central1",
    [string]$ApiService = "clinical-trial-api",
    [string]$WebService = "clinical-trial-web",
    [string]$RuntimeServiceAccount = "",
    [switch]$SkipApiDeploy
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$repoRoot = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..")).Path
$backendEnvPath = Join-Path $repoRoot "backend/.env"
$frontendEnvPath = Join-Path $repoRoot "frontend/.env"

function Read-EnvValue([string]$Path, [string]$Name) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return $null }
    $line = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\s*$([regex]::Escape($Name))\s*=" } | Select-Object -Last 1
    if (-not $line) { return $null }
    return (($line -replace "^\s*$([regex]::Escape($Name))\s*=", "").Trim().Trim('"').Trim("'"))
}

function Invoke-GCloud([string[]]$Arguments) {
    & gcloud @Arguments
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "gcloud failed with exit code ${LASTEXITCODE}: gcloud $($Arguments -join ' ')" }
}

if (-not (Get-Command gcloud -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "Google Cloud CLI (gcloud) is required. Install it and sign in with 'gcloud auth login'." }
if (-not (Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "Node.js and npm are required to build the React frontend." }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $frontendEnvPath)) { throw "Missing frontend/.env. Copy frontend/.env.example to frontend/.env and configure the Firebase web app values before deployment." }

$firebaseProjectId = Read-EnvValue $frontendEnvPath "VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID"
if (-not $firebaseProjectId -or $firebaseProjectId -match "your-|replace|placeholder") { throw "Set VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID in frontend/.env before deployment." }
foreach ($key in @("VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY", "VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN", "VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID")) {
    if (-not (Read-EnvValue $frontendEnvPath $key)) { throw "Set $key in frontend/.env before deployment." }
}

$dataProjectId = Read-EnvValue $backendEnvPath "GCP_PROJECT"
if (-not $dataProjectId) { $dataProjectId = $ProjectId }
$gcpLocation = Read-EnvValue $backendEnvPath "GCP_LOCATION"
if (-not $gcpLocation) { $gcpLocation = $Region }

Write-Host "Deploy target: $ProjectId ($Region)"
Write-Host "Application data project: $dataProjectId"
Write-Host "Firebase project: $firebaseProjectId"
Write-Host "Checking Google Cloud credentials..."
Invoke-GCloud @("auth", "print-access-token") | Out-Null

Invoke-GCloud @("services", "enable", "run.googleapis.com", "cloudbuild.googleapis.com", "artifactregistry.googleapis.com", "--project", $ProjectId, "--quiet")

if (-not $SkipApiDeploy) {
    $apiArgs = @(
        "run", "deploy", $ApiService,
        "--source", (Join-Path $repoRoot "backend"),
        "--project", $ProjectId,
        "--region", $Region,
        "--platform", "managed",
        "--allow-unauthenticated",
        "--port", "8080",
        "--memory", "2Gi",
        "--cpu", "2",
        "--timeout", "300",
        "--quiet",
        "--set-env-vars", "GCP_PROJECT=$dataProjectId,FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=$firebaseProjectId,GCP_LOCATION=$gcpLocation"
    )
    if ($RuntimeServiceAccount) { $apiArgs += @("--service-account", $RuntimeServiceAccount) }
    Invoke-GCloud $apiArgs
}
$apiUrl = (& gcloud run services describe $ApiService --project $ProjectId --region $Region --format "value(status.url)").Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $apiUrl) { throw "Could not read the deployed API URL." }

$frontendPath = Join-Path $repoRoot "frontend"
$buildStage = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("clinical-trial-ui-build-" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $buildStage | Out-Null
try {
    foreach ($item in @("package.json", "package-lock.json", "index.html", "vite.config.js", "src", "public")) {
        Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $frontendPath $item) -Destination $buildStage -Recurse
    }
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $frontendEnvPath -Destination (Join-Path $buildStage ".env")
    Push-Location $buildStage
    npm ci
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "npm ci failed in the temporary frontend build directory." }
    $env:VITE_API_BASE_URL = $apiUrl
    npm run build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Frontend production build failed." }
    Pop-Location
    $frontendDist = Join-Path $frontendPath "dist"
    $resolvedFrontend = (Resolve-Path $frontendPath).Path.TrimEnd("\") + "\"
    $resolvedDist = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($frontendDist)
    if (-not $resolvedDist.StartsWith($resolvedFrontend, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        throw "Refusing to replace a build output outside the frontend directory."
    }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $frontendDist) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $frontendDist -Recurse -Force }
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $buildStage "dist") -Destination $frontendDist -Recurse
} finally {
    Remove-Item Env:VITE_API_BASE_URL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ((Get-Location).Path -eq $buildStage) { Pop-Location }
    $resolvedTemp = (Resolve-Path $env:TEMP).Path.TrimEnd("\") + "\"
    $resolvedStage = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($buildStage)
    if ($resolvedStage.StartsWith($resolvedTemp, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resolvedStage -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}

Invoke-GCloud @(
    "run", "deploy", $WebService,
    "--source", (Join-Path $repoRoot "frontend"),
    "--project", $ProjectId,
    "--region", $Region,
    "--platform", "managed",
    "--allow-unauthenticated",
    "--port", "8080",
    "--memory", "256Mi",
    "--cpu", "1",
    "--quiet"
)
$webUrl = (& gcloud run services describe $WebService --project $ProjectId --region $Region --format "value(status.url)").Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $webUrl) { throw "Could not read the deployed web URL." }

Invoke-GCloud @("run", "services", "update", $ApiService, "--project", $ProjectId, "--region", $Region, "--update-env-vars", "CORS_ORIGINS=$webUrl")

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Cloud Run deployment complete."
Write-Host "Web: $webUrl"
Write-Host "API: $apiUrl"
Write-Host "API readiness: $apiUrl/api/ready"
Write-Host "Check that the Cloud Run runtime service account can use Firestore in $firebaseProjectId and BigQuery/Vertex AI in $dataProjectId."



========== FILE: docs\PROJECT_FILE_FLOW.md ==========

# Clinical Trial RAG: File Flow and Responsibilities

This guide follows a request from the user's browser through the backend and cloud services, then maps the main files to their jobs. It describes the current repository implementation.

## 1. System at a glance

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    User[Clinical technician] --> Browser
    subgraph Frontend[React frontend]
        Browser[main.jsx mounts app] --> Auth[AuthContext and AuthScreen]
        Auth --> App[App.jsx workspace]
        App --> Hook[useSessionManager]
        App --> API[api.js authenticated HTTP client]
        Hook --> API
        API --> Views[Results, assessment, and chat components]
    end
    API -->|HTTPS + Firebase ID token| FastAPI[backend/app/main.py]
    subgraph Backend[FastAPI backend]
        FastAPI --> AuthCheck[auth_dependency.py]
        AuthCheck --> Token[firebase_auth.py]
        FastAPI --> Routes[schemas.py request and response validation]
        FastAPI --> Pipeline[pipeline.py input checks and urgent screen]
        Pipeline --> Workflow[agents/workflow.py orchestration]
        Workflow --> Tasks[agents/tasks.py model task instructions]
        Tasks --> Runtime[agents/adk_runtime.py structured model calls]
        Workflow --> Retriever[services/retriever.py]
        Retriever --> Embed[services/embeddings.py]
        Workflow --> Judge[services/eligibility_judge.py evidence checks and verdict]
        FastAPI --> UserData[services/user_data.py]
        FastAPI --> Chat[services/chat.py]
        Workflow --> TrialStore[services/trial_store.py]
    end
    Token --> Firebase[Firebase Authentication]
    UserData --> Firestore[(Cloud Firestore: user sessions and chat)]
    Embed --> Vertex[Vertex AI embeddings]
    Retriever --> BigQuery[(BigQuery: trial chunks and vectors)]
    Runtime --> Gemini[Gemini through Google ADK]
    TrialStore --> Files[Processed JSON files]
    TrialStore -. optional copy .-> GCS[Cloud Storage]
```

## 2. What happens when a user searches

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor Technician
    participant UI as App.jsx
    participant Hook as useSessionManager.js
    participant Client as api.js
    participant Route as main.py
    participant Auth as auth_dependency.py / firebase_auth.py
    participant Store as user_data.py / Firestore
    participant Pipe as pipeline.py
    participant Flow as agents/workflow.py
    participant Search as retriever.py / embeddings.py / BigQuery
    participant AI as tasks.py / adk_runtime.py / Gemini
    participant Judge as eligibility_judge.py

    Technician->>UI: Enter a de-identified case and submit
    UI->>Hook: Select or create a session
    UI->>Client: matchPatient(case, sessionId)
    Client->>Client: Add Firebase ID token
    Client->>Route: POST /api/match
    Route->>Auth: Verify token and obtain UID
    Route->>Store: Check session ownership; save query
    Route->>Pipe: Validate case and screen urgent phrases
    Pipe->>Flow: Start matching if screening allows it
    Flow->>AI: Extract supported patient facts
    AI-->>Flow: Structured profile
    Flow->>Search: Retrieve candidate trial chunks
    Search-->>Flow: Ranked trial candidates
    opt No candidate or weak retrieval
        Flow->>AI: Propose one profile-grounded refinement
        Flow->>Search: Run at most one additional retrieval
        Search-->>Flow: Merge and deduplicate candidates
    end
    loop For shortlisted candidates (bounded)
        Flow->>AI: Assess trial criteria using supplied record text
        AI-->>Flow: Proposed criteria, quotes, and explanations
        Flow->>Judge: Verify evidence and compute conservative verdict
    end
    Flow-->>Route: Structured result and evidence
    Route->>Store: Save result under the user's session
    Route-->>Client: Match response with session ID
    Client-->>UI: Display results and clinical assessment
```

| `frontend/src/auth/AuthScreen.jsx` | Sign-in and account-creation forms. | Changing login/signup UI or validation. |
| `frontend/src/App.jsx` | Main workspace state, search submission, result selection, and navigation between views. | Connecting a new main workflow or screen. |
| `frontend/src/api.js` | HTTP functions; attaches Firebase ID token and handles API responses/errors. | Adding/changing backend requests. |
| `frontend/src/hooks/useSessionManager.js` | Loads, creates, switches, renames, and deletes saved sessions. | Changing session behavior in the browser. |
| `frontend/src/components/layout/` | Shared app shell, header, footer, and welcome area. | Changing global page layout. |
| `frontend/src/components/session/` | Session sidebar, session rows, and rename modal. | Changing saved-session controls. |
| `frontend/src/components/results/` | Results overview, trial tabs/details, criteria, evidence passages, and assessment page. | Changing match or criterion presentation. |

| `frontend/src/components/ui/` | Reusable buttons, cards, badges, dialogs, icons, artwork, skeletons, and toast. | Reusing or adjusting common controls. |

| `backend/app/services/pipeline.py` | Validates case length/identifiers, runs urgent screen, and calls the workflow. | Changing pre-match safety/input handling. |

| `backend/app/agents/adk_runtime.py` | Runs bounded Google ADK model calls and manages their temporary sessions. | Changing model invocation/runtime behavior. |
| `backend/app/agents/tools.py` | Gives agents bounded access to approved trial retrieval. | Changing model-accessible tools. |
| `backend/app/services/retriever.py` | Queries BigQuery vector search and ranks/deduplicates candidate trials. | Changing trial retrieval. |
| `backend/app/services/embeddings.py` | Calls Vertex AI to embed search text. | Changing query/document embedding behavior. |
| `backend/app/services/eligibility_judge.py` | Verifies trial/patient quotes and computes deterministic preliminary verdicts. | Changing evidence verification or verdict rules. |
| `backend/app/services/trial_store.py` | Loads processed trial records/chunks from configured storage with local fallback. | Changing trial metadata access. |
| `backend/app/services/chat.py` | Retrieves evidence for allowed trial IDs and builds grounded chat answers. | Changing follow-up question behavior. |
| `backend/app/services/safety.py`, `untrusted_text.py` | Supported-fact validation, urgent screening helpers, prompt-injection text handling. | Changing safety checks or handling of untrusted text. |

## 5. Trial data ingestion files

This is an offline preparation path. It does not run for each user search.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Fetch[fetch_trials.py<br/>Fetch and normalize trial records] --> Trials[processed/trials.json]
    FetchPMC[fetch_pmc.py<br/>Optional publication enrichment] -. optional .-> Trials
    Trials --> Chunk[chunker.py<br/>Split overview and criteria text]
    Chunk --> Build[build_index.py<br/>Prepare/validate processed index]
    Chunk --> Ingest[ingest.py<br/>Embed, validate, and load new chunks]
    Ingest --> Emb[services/embeddings.py]
    Emb --> Vertex[Vertex AI]
    Ingest --> BQ[(BigQuery trial_chunks)]
    Ingest -. optional upload .-> GCS[(Cloud Storage)]
```

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `backend/ingestion/fetch_trials.py` | Downloads ClinicalTrials.gov records and normalizes trial metadata. |
| `backend/ingestion/fetch_pmc.py` | Optional collection/enrichment from PubMed Central. |
| `backend/ingestion/chunker.py` | Splits trial records into retrieval-friendly text chunks. |
| `backend/ingestion/build_index.py` | Builds or validates local processed data/index inputs. |
| `backend/ingestion/ingest.py` | Creates embeddings, validates records, and loads chunks to BigQuery; optionally writes processed JSON to GCS. |
| `backend/sql/init_bigquery.sql`, `verify_bigquery.sql` | BigQuery setup and verification queries. |
| `backend/data/processed/trials.json`, `chunks.json` | Processed local trial records and chunk cache/fallback data. |

## 6. Other operational files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `backend/Dockerfile`, `frontend/Dockerfile` | Container build instructions for backend and frontend. |
| `frontend/nginx.conf`, `frontend/vite.config.js` | Frontend static serving and local development/build configuration. |

| `backend/tests/` | Tests for workflow, API services, retrieval, ingestion, chat, and safety. |
| `ARCHITECTURE.md` | Broader system, data, security, deployment, and production-flow diagrams. |

## 7. Where to start for common changes

| Goal | Start with |
|---|---|
| Add a screen or change interaction flow | `frontend/src/App.jsx` and the relevant `frontend/src/components/` file |
| Add an API endpoint | `backend/app/main.py`, then `backend/app/schemas.py` and `frontend/src/api.js` |
| Change saved session behavior | `backend/app/services/user_data.py`, `backend/app/main.py`, and `frontend/src/hooks/useSessionManager.js` |
| Change how patient facts are extracted | `backend/app/agents/tasks.py`, then `backend/app/agents/workflow.py` |
| Change trial search quality | `backend/app/services/retriever.py`, `backend/app/services/embeddings.py`, and ingestion data |
| Change criteria assessment | `backend/app/agents/tasks.py`, `backend/app/services/eligibility_judge.py`, and `backend/app/schemas.py` |
| Change trial data source or fields | `backend/ingestion/fetch_trials.py`, `chunker.py`, `ingest.py`, and `trial_store.py` |
| Change service configuration/deployment | `backend/app/config.py`, `.env.example`, Dockerfiles, and `deploy/` files |

The workflow provides preliminary research support. Trial evidence and criteria should remain visible so a qualified clinical team can independently review the official record.
